AX_Common_APebbleinthePond.name: A Pebble in the Pond
AX_Common_APebbleinthePond.flavorText: A single pebble can cause quite a ripple.
AX_Common_APebbleinthePond.effectDesc: Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_AbandonedDepot.name: Abandoned Depot
AX_Common_AbandonedDepot.flavorText: "There's no doubt about it... These ruins are the work of people from the City of Scholars." - Abiram
AX_Common_AbandonedDepot.effectDesc: {J} Draw a card.  When I'm sacrificed — Draw a card. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.

AX_Common_AbySapCourier.name: Aby, Sap Courier
AX_Common_AbySapCourier.flavorText: This wheel is the result of hours of mechanical training.
AX_Common_AbySapCourier.effectDesc: $<SCOUT_1> {1}. {J} You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)

AX_Common_AdaLovelace.name: Ada Lovelace
AX_Common_AdaLovelace.effectDesc: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve. If it's a Permanent, draw a card.
AX_Common_AdaLovelace.flavorText: "Imagination is the discovering faculty. It is that which penetrates the unseen worlds around us."

AX_Common_AerolithQuarry.name: Aerolith Quarry
AX_Common_AerolithQuarry.flavorText: "It took great feats of ingenuity to mine for resources at such altitude." - Isaree
AX_Common_AerolithQuarry.effectDesc: At Noon — If your opponent is first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_AerolithReef.name: Aerolith Reef
AX_Common_AerolithReef.flavorText: Reaching the pillar is no easy journey, as the clouds conceal countless reefs and other dangers.
AX_Common_AerolithReef.effectDesc: {J} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.

AX_Common_AmeliaEarhart.name: Amelia Earhart
AX_Common_AmeliaEarhart.flavorText: "The most effective way to do it, is to do it."

AX_Common_ArmoredJammer.name: Armored Jammer
AX_Common_ArmoredJammer.flavorText: "In a jam? Sorry, mate. Maybe a side-effect of our scrambling..."

AX_Common_Athena.name: Athena
AX_Common_Athena.effectDesc: {R} If you control two or more Landmarks, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.
AX_Common_Athena.flavorText: "I’ve lifted the mist from off your eyes that’s blurred them up to now."

AX_Common_Avalanche.name: Avalanche
AX_Common_Avalanche.flavorText: None of the snowflakes feel personally guilty for the avalanche.
AX_Common_Avalanche.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve any number of target Characters with total {M} of 4 or less.

AX_Common_AxiomExhibit.name: Axiom Exhibit
AX_Common_AxiomExhibit.flavorText: "Let's show the Reka the brilliance of Axiom ingenuity!"
AX_Common_AxiomExhibit.effectDesc: {T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_AxiomMachinist.name: Axiom Machinist
AX_Common_AxiomMachinist.flavorText: From Kelon to Sap to Manaseed, the Axiom never stop experimenting with alternative energy sources.
AX_Common_AxiomMachinist.effectDesc: {H} You may ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve.

AX_Common_AxiomPuppeteer.name: Axiom Puppeteer
AX_Common_AxiomPuppeteer.flavorText: "In rock-paper-scissors, I always win by a knockout."
AX_Common_AxiomPuppeteer.effectDesc: {H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)

AX_Common_AxiomReprocessor.name: Axiom Reprocessor
AX_Common_AxiomReprocessor.flavorText: Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed.

AX_Common_AxiomSalvager.name: Axiom Salvager
AX_Common_AxiomSalvager.flavorText: The Axiom's limited resources pushed them to reuse whatever they could.

AX_Common_AxiomScrambler.name: Axiom Scrambler
AX_Common_AxiomScrambler.flavorText: Pushing back the Tumult sometimes prevents other Alterers from materializing their Eidolons. Regrettable, but necessary.

AX_Common_AxiomSignet.name: Axiom Signet
AX_Common_AxiomSignet.effectDesc: Choose one:  • Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  • Target Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.

AX_Common_BessieColeman.name: Bessie Coleman
AX_Common_BessieColeman.flavorText: "I was destined to fly. I was born to fly." - Bessie
AX_Common_BessieColeman.effectDesc: When you sacrifice a Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.

AX_Common_Boom.name: Boom!
AX_Common_Boom.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.
AX_Common_Boom.flavorText: "Catastrophic failure? I prefer the term 'learning opportunity'."

AX_Common_Brassbug.name: Brassbug
AX_Common_Brassbug.effectDesc: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)

AX_Common_BrassbugDropship.name: Brassbug Dropship
AX_Common_BrassbugDropship.flavorText: "Those little pests are tough. Even three miles up, they still manage to follow us." - Subhash
AX_Common_BrassbugDropship.effectDesc: When I'm sacrificed — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in each of your Expeditions. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)

AX_Common_BrassbugHive.name: Brassbug Hive
AX_Common_BrassbugHive.effectDesc: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  At Noon — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_BrassbugHive.flavorText: What could possibly go wrong with an adorable little self-replicating autonomous robot?

AX_Common_BrassbugHub.name: Brassbug Hub
AX_Common_BrassbugHub.effectDesc: {J} I gain three Kelon counters.  At Noon — You may pay {1} and spend one of my Kelon counters to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_BrassbugHub.flavorText: Few people visit the depths of the Foundry, and even fewer can explain how the Brassbugs came to be.

AX_Common_BrassbugNursery.name: Brassbug Nursery
AX_Common_BrassbugNursery.flavorText: Even far from their Hive, the Brassbugs have developed a way to continue reproducing.
AX_Common_BrassbugNursery.effectDesc: {J} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")  {T}, {1}, Sacrifice a Permanent: create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

AX_Common_BugOutBag.name: Bug-Out Bag
AX_Common_BugOutBag.flavorText: They forgot to pack the Eat Me energy bars.
AX_Common_BugOutBag.effectDesc: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in my Expedition.

AX_Common_Bugfix.name: Bugfix
AX_Common_Bugfix.flavorText: It's not Kelon, but this Sap will make you feel better, I swear.
AX_Common_Bugfix.effectDesc: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

AX_Common_Coppelia.name: Coppélia
AX_Common_Coppelia.effectDesc: When I go to Reserve from your hand — You may play me for free and I gain $<ASLEEP>.
AX_Common_Coppelia.flavorText: Because of her artificial nature, she served as a model for the Faction's first Automata prototypes.

AX_Common_CorruptedPaju.name: Corrupted Paju
AX_Common_CorruptedPaju.flavorText: "Why did you survive, Treyst… but I died?"
AX_Common_CorruptedPaju.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless your hand is empty.  {R} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_DaringPorter.name: Daring Porter
AX_Common_DaringPorter.flavorText: Someone has to shoulder the heavy burden of responsibility.
AX_Common_DaringPorter.effectDesc: {R} <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_DellaBolt.name: Della & Bolt
AX_Common_DellaBolt.flavorText: Living creatures are the most beautiful mechanisms of all.
AX_Common_DellaBolt.effectDesc: {T} : Ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve. This costs {2} more to target a Permanent in play with Hand Cost {5} or more.

AX_Common_DemolitionExpert.name: Demolition Expert
AX_Common_DemolitionExpert.flavorText: Mining aerolith is dangerous, but it's well worth the risk.
AX_Common_DemolitionExpert.effectDesc: {H} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")  {R} You may sacrifice a Permanent.

AX_Common_DesignerDrone.name: Designer Drone
AX_Common_DesignerDrone.flavorText: Designed by designers to help them design.
AX_Common_DesignerDrone.supportDesc: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.

AX_Common_Detonation.name: Detonation
AX_Common_Detonation.flavorText: Aerolith's instability can turn any bump into an explosive reaction.
AX_Common_Detonation.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  You may sacrifice a Permanent to reduce my cost by {1}.  Send target Character to Reserve.

AX_Common_DrFrankenstein.name: Dr. Frankenstein
AX_Common_DrFrankenstein.effectDesc: {R} You may activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.
AX_Common_DrFrankenstein.flavorText: We sometimes seek companionship in the strangest of life forms.

AX_Common_DredgerDrone.name: Dredger Drone
AX_Common_DredgerDrone.flavorText: The more you dig, the better your chances of finding something unique.
AX_Common_DredgerDrone.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to <RESUPPLY_INF>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
AX_Common_DredgerDrone.supportDesc: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.

AX_Common_Drillmole.name: Drillmole
AX_Common_Drillmole.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
AX_Common_Drillmole.supportDesc: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.

AX_Common_EmergencyBurst.name: Emergency Burst
AX_Common_EmergencyBurst.flavorText: If Aerolith can defy gravity, it can also deny evil!
AX_Common_EmergencyBurst.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less if there are no other cards in your hand.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, Hand Cost if not.)

AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.name: Enhanced Prototype
AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.flavorText: It's no longer flawed, but there's still room for improvement.
AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to ready two Mana Orbs.
AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.supportDesc: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.

AX_Common_FabLabUnit.name: Fab Lab Unit
AX_Common_FabLabUnit.flavorText: All the power of the Foundry distilled into this miracle of technology.
AX_Common_FabLabUnit.effectDesc: {T} : The next Character played from your hand in my Expedition this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.

AX_Common_FailedDemo.name: Failed Demo
AX_Common_FailedDemo.flavorText: Not a failure; just another step towards success.
AX_Common_FailedDemo.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve. If you do, send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or Hand Cost if not.)

AX_Common_FarFetch20.name: FarFetch 2.0
AX_Common_FarFetch20.flavorText: "I'm glad I got my hooks into this new version!" - Paju
AX_Common_FarFetch20.effectDesc: {J} You may sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

AX_Common_FlawedPrototype.name: Flawed Prototype
AX_Common_FlawedPrototype.flavorText: "If we could just find a substitute for the missing parts, we could make it work."
AX_Common_FlawedPrototype.effectDesc: {J} Sacrifice another Robot or Permanent. If you can't, sacrifice me.

AX_Common_FoundryArmorer.name: Foundry Armorer
AX_Common_FoundryArmorer.effectDesc: {R} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_FoundryArmorer.flavorText: No Brassbug would survive in the Tumult without armor.

AX_Common_FoundryEngineer.name: Foundry Engineer
AX_Common_FoundryEngineer.effectDesc: {R} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs {1} less.
AX_Common_FoundryEngineer.flavorText: Behind every Axiom masterwork, there are Foundry Engineers.

AX_Common_FoundryMechanic.name: Foundry Mechanic
AX_Common_FoundryMechanic.supportDesc: {D} : The next Permanent you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Common_FoundryMechanic.flavorText: You can't choose when and where a quick fix will be needed.

AX_Common_FrankensteinsCreature.name: Frankenstein's Creature
AX_Common_FrankensteinsCreature.flavorText: It's by shunning differences that true monsters are born.
AX_Common_FrankensteinsCreature.effectDesc: {R} You may target a Permanent you control with Base Cost {2} or less. It activates its {j} abilities.

AX_Common_FrozenDelivery.name: Frozen Delivery
AX_Common_FrozenDelivery.flavorText: Precious supplies. If only the lid wasn't frozen shut...
AX_Common_FrozenDelivery.effectDesc: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  $<RESUPPLY>.

AX_Common_FrozenReprocessor.name: Frozen Reprocessor
AX_Common_FrozenReprocessor.flavorText: Nothing is created, nothing is lost... even to the frost.
AX_Common_FrozenReprocessor.effectDesc: At Noon — <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  You may keep one more card in Reserve during Night if it's exhausted.

AX_Common_Ganesha.name: Ganesha
AX_Common_Ganesha.effectDesc: {J} For each Permanent you control, you may activate its {j} abilities.
AX_Common_Ganesha.flavorText: Knowledge and wisdom must walk side by side.

AX_Common_Gavroche.name: Gavroche
AX_Common_Gavroche.flavorText: He fills his basket and retorts by thumbing his nose.
AX_Common_Gavroche.effectDesc: {R} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_Gibil.name: Gibil
AX_Common_Gibil.flavorText: Symphonies begin with two notes, fires with a couple of sparks, and masterpieces with two drops of metal.
AX_Common_Gibil.effectDesc: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_Gibil.supportDesc: {D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

AX_Common_Hooked.name: Hooked
AX_Common_Hooked.effectDesc: Target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

AX_Common_HopomyThumb.name: Hop-o'-my-Thumb
AX_Common_HopomyThumb.flavorText: It's not easy to lead the way…
AX_Common_HopomyThumb.effectDesc: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_Icarus.name: Icarus
AX_Common_Icarus.flavorText: This time, I hope the Sap wax will hold.
AX_Common_Icarus.effectDesc: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  {J} Ready all cards in your Reserve.

AX_Common_IceboundHollow.name: Icebound Hollow
AX_Common_IceboundHollow.flavorText: In the caves and crevices, it wails and calls to us.
AX_Common_IceboundHollow.effectDesc: When a card goes from your Hand or deck to Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then ready your cards in Reserve.

AX_Common_InariSpiritofIndustry.name: Inari, Spirit of Industry
AX_Common_InariSpiritofIndustry.flavorText: Everything contains a need to grow, be it a grain of rice or human being.
AX_Common_InariSpiritofIndustry.effectDesc: When you pass — If your hand is empty, draw a card.

AX_Common_IraFairAttendee.name: Ira, Fair Attendee
AX_Common_IraFairAttendee.flavorText: "One day, son, you'll show off your own creations here." — Della

AX_Common_IsareePebble.name: Isaree & Pebble
AX_Common_IsareePebble.flavorText: Science's role is to serve the people, not the other way around
AX_Common_IsareePebble.effectDesc: At Noon — If you are first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_JianAssemblyOverseer.name: Jian, Assembly Overseer
AX_Common_JianAssemblyOverseer.flavorText: "This material does not seem to be affected by gravity. By harnessing the properties of this Aerolith, we could create flying ships and cities, and fly close to the clouds..."

AX_Common_KelonBurst.name: Kelon Burst
AX_Common_KelonBurst.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.
AX_Common_KelonBurst.flavorText: There's an enduring legend in the Suspira quarries: the existence of another type of Kelon.

AX_Common_KelonCylinder.name: Kelon Cylinder
AX_Common_KelonCylinder.effectDesc: {T} : I gain two Kelon counters.  {T}, Spend one of my Kelon counters: the next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost $<BB>.
AX_Common_KelonCylinder.flavorText: This little battery is Axiom's trump card. The Kelon produces phenomenal energy for which engineers find new applications every day.

AX_Common_KelonElemental.name: Kelon Elemental
AX_Common_KelonElemental.effectDesc: {H} Put a card from your hand in Reserve.
AX_Common_KelonElemental.flavorText: In true Axiom fashion, Kelon Elementals like to put everything to the taste.

AX_Common_KelonicGenerator.name: Kelonic Generator
AX_Common_KelonicGenerator.flavorText: "Suspira's mines will soon run dry. Your precious Kelon will run dry."

AX_Common_KelonicHeater.name: Kelonic Heater
AX_Common_KelonicHeater.flavorText: A bit of warmth goes a long way in brightening a cold day.
AX_Common_KelonicHeater.effectDesc: {J} $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.  You may play exhausted Characters from your Reserve in my Expedition.

AX_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
AX_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effectDesc: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_LeonardodaVinci.name: Leonardo da Vinci
AX_Common_LeonardodaVinci.flavorText: "The noblest pleasure is the joy of understanding." — Leonardo da Vinci
AX_Common_LeonardodaVinci.effectDesc: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to $<RESUPPLY_INF>.

AX_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
AX_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effectDesc: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

AX_Common_LordKelvin.name: Lord Kelvin
AX_Common_LordKelvin.flavorText: "When you are face to face with a difficulty, you are up against a discovery."
AX_Common_LordKelvin.effectDesc: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_LucanHungryLeviathan.name: Lucan, Hungry Leviathan
AX_Common_LucanHungryLeviathan.flavorText: It bursts out of the clouds to devour our metal shuttles.
AX_Common_LucanHungryLeviathan.effectDesc: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} You may discard any number of cards from your Reserve to give me that many boosts.

AX_Common_MakeitWork.name: Make it Work
AX_Common_MakeitWork.flavorText: "Come on, almost there, you've got this!"
AX_Common_MakeitWork.effectDesc: {J} Put a card from your hand in Reserve.  When you pass — If your hand is empty, complete me.

AX_Common_MarieCurie.name: Marie Curie
AX_Common_MarieCurie.flavorText: "It is important to make a dream of life and of a dream reality."

AX_Common_MasterLapidary.name: Master Lapidary
AX_Common_MasterLapidary.flavorText: Cutting Aerolith requires a deft and delicate touch.

AX_Common_MechanicalTraining.name: Mechanical Training
AX_Common_MechanicalTraining.effectDesc: Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.
AX_Common_MechanicalTraining.flavorText: To learn to create, first learn to fix.

AX_Common_Medusa.name: Medusa
AX_Common_Medusa.flavorText: They made her a monster simply for defending herself.
AX_Common_Medusa.effectDesc: {R} You may discard target Character. If you do, create an <AEROLITH> token in its controller's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

AX_Common_NikolaTesla.name: Nikola Tesla
AX_Common_NikolaTesla.flavorText: "With this new invention, we can generate a force field to protect the city!"
AX_Common_NikolaTesla.effectDesc: {R} I gain 1 boost if you control an exhausted Permanent or if there's an exhausted card in your Reserve.

AX_Common_Ogun.name: Ogun
AX_Common_Ogun.flavorText: With every blow of his hammer, Ogun forges the Axiom's destiny.

AX_Common_PajuAxiomPilot.name: Paju, Axiom Pilot
AX_Common_PajuAxiomPilot.flavorText: "Look, Paju. Wandering unknown skies was our dream, and now we've achieved it." - Treyst
AX_Common_PajuAxiomPilot.supportDesc: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

AX_Common_RekaBioengineer.name: Reka Bioengineer
AX_Common_RekaBioengineer.flavorText: In the wild rush to find new uses for Manaseeds, it seems the sky's the limit…
AX_Common_RekaBioengineer.effectDesc: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve to create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

AX_Common_RekaMagnate.name: Reka Magnate
AX_Common_RekaMagnate.flavorText: "A disruptive smoothie to knock the competition off balance!"
AX_Common_RekaMagnate.effectDesc: {R} Choose one:  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

AX_Common_RekaRecycler.name: Reka Recycler
AX_Common_RekaRecycler.flavorText: In with the old, and out comes the new!
AX_Common_RekaRecycler.effectDesc: {H} You may discard two cards from your Reserve to draw a card.

AX_Common_RekaScavenger.name: Reka Scavenger
AX_Common_RekaScavenger.flavorText: "I need to bring this back to Isaree as soon as possible!"
AX_Common_RekaScavenger.effectDesc: When you pass — If there's at most one card in your hand, I gain 1 boost.

AX_Common_RekaWelder.name: Reka Welder
AX_Common_RekaWelder.flavorText: It's at times like these that we need to stick together.
AX_Common_RekaWelder.effectDesc: You play Permanents for {1} less, down to a minimum of {1}. (Other effects may reduce it further.)

AX_Common_RestockingStation.name: Restocking Station
AX_Common_RestockingStation.flavorText: "Kelon powers our engines, aerolith gives us access to the skies. What heights will we reach with the other two Primordiae?" - Basem
AX_Common_RestockingStation.effectDesc: {J} I gain 2 Kelon counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Kelon counters: target Character loses <FLEETING>.

AX_Common_RocketPuffin.name: Rocket Puffin
AX_Common_RocketPuffin.flavorText: Blasting off at the speed of light!
AX_Common_RocketPuffin.effectDesc: {J} You may ready an exhausted card in Reserve.

AX_Common_SapExtractor.name: Sap Extractor
AX_Common_SapExtractor.flavorText: The Sap courses through the whole city like blood in a mortal's veins.
AX_Common_SapExtractor.effectDesc: At Noon — You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)

AX_Common_SapOverflow.name: Sap Overflow
AX_Common_SapOverflow.flavorText: With every dig, the Sap becomes riskier to harvest.
AX_Common_SapOverflow.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Discard target Character in play or in Reserve.

AX_Common_SapSniffer.name: Sap Sniffer
AX_Common_SapSniffer.flavorText: Indigenous to the ruins, these little creatures can smell Sap from a mile away.
AX_Common_SapSniffer.effectDesc: {R} You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)

AX_Common_ScienceFair.name: Science Fair
AX_Common_ScienceFair.flavorText: At this convention, the Reka show off their scientific superiority.
AX_Common_ScienceFair.effectDesc: {T} : Put a card from your hand in Reserve. If you do, draw a card.

AX_Common_ShiramunTechMonk.name: Shiramun, Tech Monk
AX_Common_ShiramunTechMonk.flavorText: Building walls, to keep the monsters at bay.
AX_Common_ShiramunTechMonk.effectDesc: {H} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one card from a Reserve.)

AX_Common_ShortageSupervisor.name: Shortage Supervisor
AX_Common_ShortageSupervisor.flavorText: With the appropriate tech, Sap can exhibit energetic properties sufficient to replace Kelon.
AX_Common_ShortageSupervisor.effectDesc: {R} If your hand is empty, I gain 1 boost.

AX_Common_SierraOddball.name: Sierra & Oddball
AX_Common_SierraOddball.effectDesc: When you play a Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or more — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_SierraOddball.flavorText: I don't know if there's a better reward than seeing something you've built come to life.

AX_Common_SneakySalamander.name: Sneaky Salamander
AX_Common_SneakySalamander.flavorText: Perfect for slipping under the radar.
AX_Common_SneakySalamander.effectDesc: {H} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve.

AX_Common_StigmaofStagnation.name: Stigma of Stagnation
AX_Common_StigmaofStagnation.flavorText: Fear of change leads to stagnation.

AX_Common_SubhashMarmo.name: Subhash & Marmo
AX_Common_SubhashMarmo.effectDesc: At Noon — You may pay {1} and put a card from your hand in Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_SubhashMarmo.flavorText: There are still endless possibilities, even in a world of finite resources. In the end, it all comes down to how you choose to spend 'em.

AX_Common_TechLabUnit.name: Tech Lab Unit
AX_Common_TechLabUnit.effectDesc: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  Your Reserve limit is increased by one.

AX_Common_TechnologicalEncounter.name: Technological Encounter
AX_Common_TechnologicalEncounter.flavorText: "The fruit of our research will lead our peoples to new heights."
AX_Common_TechnologicalEncounter.effectDesc: $<COOLDOWN>.  Draw a card, then create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

AX_Common_TheConsortium.name: The Consortium
AX_Common_TheConsortium.flavorText: The epicenter of Reka research, focused on perpetual growth.
AX_Common_TheConsortium.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  {T} : Target Character in Reserve gains 2 boosts.

AX_Common_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.name: The Foundry, Axiom Bastion
AX_Common_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.flavorText: Embedded in the cliff wall, it overlooks the city and reminds everyone who looks up at it that nothing is unreachable if you put your mind to it.
AX_Common_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.effectDesc: {T} : The next Character you play from your hand this turn activates its {r} abilities (as if it had been played from Reserve).

AX_Common_TheGrems.name: The Grems
AX_Common_TheGrems.flavorText: It's not demolition, but basic recycling. Or so they say.
AX_Common_TheGrems.effectDesc: {R} Choose up to one:  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.  • Sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

AX_Common_TheLittleMatchGirl.name: The Little Match Girl
AX_Common_TheLittleMatchGirl.flavorText: When you're alone in the cold, even the tiniest light can feel like salvation.
AX_Common_TheLittleMatchGirl.effectDesc: {R} If your hand is empty, draw a card.

AX_Common_TheMachineintheIce.name: The Machine in the Ice
AX_Common_TheMachineintheIce.flavorText: A relic left by those who came before.
AX_Common_TheMachineintheIce.effectDesc: When I go to Reserve from anywhere — Exhaust me ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  {H} Send me to Reserve.

AX_Common_TheRefinery.name: The Refinery
AX_Common_TheRefinery.flavorText: The use of Sap will alter the course of science as we know it.
AX_Common_TheRefinery.effectDesc: When a card leaves your Reserve during the Afternoon — I gain 1 Sap counter.  {T}, Spend 3 of my Sap counters: Characters in your Reserve gain 1 boost.

AX_Common_TheShell.name: The Shell
AX_Common_TheShell.effectDesc: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to draw a card.

AX_Common_ThomasEdison.name: Thomas Edison
AX_Common_ThomasEdison.flavorText: "Thanks to MY new invention, the city is safe!"
AX_Common_ThomasEdison.effectDesc: {J} You may discard a Character from your Reserve. If you do, I activate one of its {r} abilities as if it was mine.

AX_Common_ThreeLittlePigs.name: Three Little Pigs
AX_Common_ThreeLittlePigs.effectDesc: {J} If you control two or more Landmarks, I gain 1 boost$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
AX_Common_ThreeLittlePigs.flavorText: Together they can build more than just a stone house.

AX_Common_TikTok.name: Tik-Tok
AX_Common_TikTok.effectDesc: {H} Exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control or a card in your Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_TinkerBell.name: Tinker Bell
AX_Common_TinkerBell.flavorText: Ting! Ting-a-ling! There's something magical in mischievous tinkering...

AX_Common_TotingArmadillo.name: Toting Armadillo
AX_Common_TotingArmadillo.flavorText: Its shell has inspired the shields’ design.
AX_Common_TotingArmadillo.effectDesc: {H} Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this Afternoon, down to a minimum of {1}. (Other effects may reduce it further.)

AX_Common_TreystRossum.name: Treyst & Rossum
AX_Common_TreystRossum.flavorText: An energy system is a piece of subtle machinery to be optimized for better output.
AX_Common_TreystRossum.effectDesc: When a card leaves your Reserve during the Afternoon — if I have less than five Scrap counters, I gain a Scrap counter.  If I have five or more Scrap counters, I gain \"{T} : Draw a card, then put a card from your hand in Reserve.\"

AX_Common_VaikeEnergyPioneer.name: Vaike, Energy Pioneer
AX_Common_VaikeEnergyPioneer.flavorText: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
AX_Common_VaikeEnergyPioneer.effectDesc: You may play exhausted cards from your Reserve.

AX_Common_VendingBot.name: Vending Bot
AX_Common_VendingBot.effectDesc: {R} <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_Vishvakarma.name: Vishvakarma
AX_Common_Vishvakarma.flavorText: Each construction is a poem, and building is an act of eloquence.
AX_Common_Vishvakarma.effectDesc: {J} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs {4} less.

AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.name: Deploy the Shields!
AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.flavorText: "Our task is simple: block the Nightmare's path!" — Isaree
AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.effectDesc: {J} If there are no tokens in your Landmarks, create an <AEROLITH> token there.  When you pass — If three cards or more are in your Landmarks, complete me.
AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you sacrifice a Permanent — Target non-<BOOSTED> Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.

AX_Exalted_PlagueofAvarice.name: Plague of Avarice
AX_Exalted_PlagueofAvarice.flavorText: The pursuit of progress is like an insatiable hunger.
AX_Exalted_PlagueofAvarice.effectDesc: {H} Each Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  When you pass — Sacrifice a Permanent.

AX_Exalted_SphuraRekaHexarch.name: Sphura, Reka Hexarch
AX_Exalted_SphuraRekaHexarch.flavorText: "The Juice is more than just energy; it's our lifeblood!"
AX_Exalted_SphuraRekaHexarch.effectDesc: Play me for {1} less if you control an exhausted Permanent.  Play me for {1} less if there's an exhausted card in your Reserve.  {J} If there are four or more exhausted cards among Permanents you control and cards in your Reserve, ready up to two of them.

AX_Rare_APebbleinthePond.name: A Pebble in the Pond
AX_Rare_APebbleinthePond.flavorText: A single pebble can cause quite a ripple.
AX_Rare_APebbleinthePond.effectDesc: #Play me for {1} less if there are no tokens in your Landmarks.#  Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.

AX_Rare_AbandonedDepot.name: Abandoned Depot
AX_Rare_AbandonedDepot.flavorText: "There's no doubt about it... These ruins are the work of people from the City of Scholars." - Abiram
AX_Rare_AbandonedDepot.effectDesc: {J} Draw a card.  When I'm sacrificed — #<RESUPPLY>.# (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.

AX_Rare_AbySapCourier.name: Aby, Sap Courier
AX_Rare_AbySapCourier.flavorText: This wheel is the result of hours of mechanical training.
AX_Rare_AbySapCourier.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {J} <AUGMENT_IMP> #any number# of target cards in play or in Reserve. (If they have counters, they gain 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)

AX_Rare_AdaLovelace.name: Ada Lovelace
AX_Rare_AdaLovelace.flavorText: "Imagination is the discovering faculty. It is that which penetrates the unseen worlds around us."
AX_Rare_AdaLovelace.effectDesc: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve #to draw a card#.

AX_Rare_AegisTemplar.name: Aegis Templar
AX_Rare_AegisTemplar.flavorText: The Templars always ensure that the area is safe.
AX_Rare_AegisTemplar.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create a #<BRASSBUG> Robot# token in my Expedition.

AX_Rare_AerolithQuarry.name: Aerolith Quarry
AX_Rare_AerolithQuarry.flavorText: "It took great feats of ingenuity to mine for resources at such altitude." - Isaree
AX_Rare_AerolithQuarry.effectDesc: At Noon — If your opponent is first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.  #When you sacrifice a Permanent — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give target Character 1 boost.#

AX_Rare_AerolithReef.name: Aerolith Reef
AX_Rare_AerolithReef.flavorText: Reaching the pillar is no easy journey, as the clouds conceal countless reefs and other dangers.
AX_Rare_AerolithReef.effectDesc: {J} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  #When I'm sacrificed — <RESUPPLY>.  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.#

AX_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.name: Alelo, Eerie Leviathan
AX_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.flavorText: We followed in its wake, believing it was a magical current.
AX_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.effectDesc: <GIGANTIC>.  I'm also considered an #Expedition Permanent,# even when not in play. (Play me as a Character, but it counts as playing a Permanent for other abilities.)

AX_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.name: Amahle, Asgarthan Outcast
AX_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.flavorText: The old world is dying, and the new world struggles to be born: now is the time of monsters.
AX_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.effectDesc: {J} You may discard a card from your Reserve to draw a card.

AX_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.name: Amelia Earhart
AX_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.flavorText: "The most effective way to do it, is to do it."

AX_Rare_Anansi.name: Anansi
AX_Rare_Anansi.flavorText: In the end, he had accumulated pretty well all the wisdom that was available. He put it in a gourd and made a stopper for it.
AX_Rare_Anansi.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost for each card in your Reserve.

AX_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.name: Arcolano Milk
AX_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.flavorText: Nobody knows where this "milk" actually comes from.
AX_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.effectDesc: When a Character joins my Expedition — It gains 1 boost and <FLEETING_CHAR>.

AX_Rare_ArmoredJammer.name: Armored Jammer
AX_Rare_ArmoredJammer.flavorText: "In a jam? Sorry, mate. Maybe a side-effect of our scrambling..."

AX_Rare_Athena.name: Athena
AX_Rare_Athena.flavorText: "I’ve lifted the mist from off your eyes that’s blurred them up to now."
AX_Rare_Athena.effectDesc: #{H} If you control two or more Landmarks, I gain 2 boosts.#  {R} If you control two or more Landmarks, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.

AX_Rare_Avalanche.name: Avalanche
AX_Rare_Avalanche.flavorText: None of the snowflakes feel personally guilty for the avalanche.
AX_Rare_Avalanche.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve any number of target Characters with #total {M} of 5 or less#.

AX_Rare_AxiomExhibit.name: Axiom Exhibit
AX_Rare_AxiomExhibit.flavorText: "Let's show the Reka the brilliance of Axiom ingenuity!"
AX_Rare_AxiomExhibit.effectDesc: {T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then exhaust it ({T}).  #{T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then ready it.#

AX_Rare_AxiomMachinist.name: Axiom Machinist
AX_Rare_AxiomMachinist.flavorText: From Kelon to Sap to Manaseed, the Axiom never stop experimenting with alternative energy sources.
AX_Rare_AxiomMachinist.effectDesc: #{J}# You may ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve.

AX_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.name: Axiom Puppeteer
AX_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.flavorText: "In rock-paper-scissors, I always win by a knockout."
AX_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.effectDesc: {H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to <SABOTAGE_INF>.  #When you sacrifice a Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.#

AX_Rare_AxiomReprocessor.name: Axiom Reprocessor
AX_Rare_AxiomReprocessor.flavorText: Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed.

AX_Rare_AxiomSalvager.name: Axiom Salvager
AX_Rare_AxiomSalvager.flavorText: The Axiom's limited resources pushed them to reuse whatever they could.

AX_Rare_AxiomScrambler.name: Axiom Scrambler
AX_Rare_AxiomScrambler.flavorText: Pushing back the Tumult sometimes prevents other Alterers from materializing their Eidolons. Regrettable, but necessary.

AX_Rare_AxiomSignet.name: Axiom Signet
AX_Rare_AxiomSignet.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  • Target Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.

AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.name: BLISS Drummer
AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.flavorText: "Throw your hands up in the air for everyone who's hauling out those amazing relics from the City of Scholars!" — Tamati
AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.effectDesc: If I'm <BOOSTED>, #Robots# cost {1} less to play from your Reserve, with a minimum of {1}.
AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.supportDesc: {I} #At Noon — Choose one:#  • I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 3.#  • #{T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.#

AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.name: BLISS Keytarist
AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.flavorText: "Make some noise for all the brave folks pulling Sap up from the depths!" — Orbec
AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.effectDesc: At Dusk — If I'm <BOOSTED>, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a #Robot# or #Permanent#, draw it. Otherwise, discard it.
AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.supportDesc: {I} #At Noon — Choose one:# • I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 3.# • #{T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.#

AX_Rare_Baku.name: Baku
AX_Rare_Baku.flavorText: "I’ve seen it myself! 'Baku! Baku!', it says, eating up ghosts as though they were candies."
AX_Rare_Baku.effectDesc: {H} Target opponent discards a card from their hand.

AX_Rare_Beowulf.name: Beowulf
AX_Rare_Beowulf.flavorText: "Each of us must suffer death; let he who is able cover himself in glory (before the end)!" - Beowulf
AX_Rare_Beowulf.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition zone — You may play a #Permanent# with #Base Cost {3} or less# for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)

AX_Rare_BessieColeman.name: Bessie Coleman
AX_Rare_BessieColeman.flavorText: "I was destined to fly. I was born to fly." - Bessie
AX_Rare_BessieColeman.effectDesc: When you sacrifice a Permanent — If I have #less than 2 boosts,# I gain 1 boost.

AX_Rare_Blizzard.name: Blizzard
AX_Rare_Blizzard.flavorText: The icy winds wrecked the army, despite months of preparation.
AX_Rare_Blizzard.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve each Character from target Expedition, then exhaust them ({T}).

AX_Rare_Bluecap.name: Bluecap
AX_Rare_Bluecap.flavorText: To avoid sudden jolts, invest in stone.
AX_Rare_Bluecap.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.

AX_Rare_Boom.name: Boom!
AX_Rare_Boom.flavorText: "Catastrophic failure? I prefer the term 'learning opportunity'."
AX_Rare_Boom.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character #or Permanent#. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.

AX_Rare_BrassbugDropship.name: Brassbug Dropship
AX_Rare_BrassbugDropship.flavorText: "Those little pests are tough. Even three miles up, they still manage to follow us." - Subhash
AX_Rare_BrassbugDropship.effectDesc: When I'm sacrificed — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in each of your Expeditions. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)

AX_Rare_BrassbugHive.name: Brassbug Hive
AX_Rare_BrassbugHive.flavorText: What could possibly go wrong with an adorable little self-replicating autonomous robot?
AX_Rare_BrassbugHive.effectDesc: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  At Noon — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  #When a Robot joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.#

AX_Rare_BrassbugHub.name: Brassbug Hub
AX_Rare_BrassbugHub.flavorText: Few people visit the depths of the Foundry, and even fewer can explain how the Brassbugs came to be.
AX_Rare_BrassbugHub.effectDesc: {J} I gain three Kelon counters.  At Noon — You may pay {1} and spend one of my Kelon counters to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

AX_Rare_BrassbugNursery.name: Brassbug Nursery
AX_Rare_BrassbugNursery.flavorText: Even far from their Hive, the Brassbugs have developed a way to continue reproducing.
AX_Rare_BrassbugNursery.effectDesc: {T}, {1}, Sacrifice a Permanent: create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

AX_Rare_BravosCloudhog.name: Bravos Cloudhog
AX_Rare_BravosCloudhog.flavorText: "Ladies and gentlemen, you are about to experience some turbulence."
AX_Rare_BravosCloudhog.effectDesc: {R} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a Character this way, I gain #2 boosts, otherwise I gain 1 boost.#

AX_Rare_BravosExcavator.name: Bravos Excavator
AX_Rare_BravosExcavator.flavorText: The depths of the city are filled with archaeological marvels... along with plenty of Sap!
AX_Rare_BravosExcavator.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition zone, for each of my boosts — You may #<AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve.# (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)

AX_Rare_BravosLookout.name: Bravos Lookout
AX_Rare_BravosLookout.flavorText: "I think I've found a good spot!"
AX_Rare_BravosLookout.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.#

AX_Rare_BravosRescuer.name: Bravos Rescuer
AX_Rare_BravosRescuer.flavorText: "Their ranks will be composed of seasoned argonauts, ready to face the perils of the unknown!"
AX_Rare_BravosRescuer.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character loses <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

AX_Rare_BravosTracer.name: Bravos Tracer
AX_Rare_BravosTracer.flavorText: "I only feel alive when I hear the wind whistling in my ears."
AX_Rare_BravosTracer.effectDesc: {J} I gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If I would be sent to Reserve, discard me instead.)

AX_Rare_BravosVanguard.name: Bravos Vanguard
AX_Rare_BravosVanguard.flavorText: "We will be the arrow that pierces the veil of the unknown, the torch that banishes the mists of ignorance!"
AX_Rare_BravosVanguard.effectDesc: {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING_CHAR> #and gain 1 boost#.

AX_Rare_BugOutBag.name: Bug-Out Bag
AX_Rare_BugOutBag.flavorText: They forgot to pack the Eat Me energy bars.
AX_Rare_BugOutBag.effectDesc: #{H}# Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in my Expedition.  #{R} <RESUPPLY>.#

AX_Rare_Bugfix.name: Bugfix
AX_Rare_Bugfix.flavorText: It's not Kelon, but this Sap will make you feel better, I swear.
AX_Rare_Bugfix.effectDesc: <COOLDOWN>.  You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.name: Carmela, Fast Striker
AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.flavorText: "I only feel alive when I'm on the very edge!"
AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.effectDesc: #{J}# If you control a #<COMPLETED_LOW># Feat, #I lose <FLEETING>.#
AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.supportDesc: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Feat you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.#

AX_Rare_CatsCradle.name: Cat's Cradle
AX_Rare_CatsCradle.flavorText: "Time to let the cat out of the bag!"
AX_Rare_CatsCradle.effectDesc: Target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less# switches Expeditions, then gains <ANCHORED>.

AX_Rare_Coppelia.name: Coppélia
AX_Rare_Coppelia.flavorText: Because of her artificial nature, she served as a model for the Faction's first Automata prototypes.
AX_Rare_Coppelia.effectDesc: When I go to Reserve from your hand — You may play me for free and I gain $<ASLEEP>.

AX_Rare_CorruptedAoife.name: Corrupted Aoife
AX_Rare_CorruptedAoife.flavorText: "Are you sure you want to add fuel to the fire?"
AX_Rare_CorruptedAoife.effectDesc: #I can't be played# unless you control a Feat.  {R} You may target another Character. It loses <FLEETING> and gains 1 boost.

AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.name: Corrupted Esmeralda
AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.flavorText: \"Are you sure you want to follow me into hell, Fen ?\"
AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.effectDesc: I #can't be played# unless a {D} ability was activated this turn.  #{J}# <RESUPPLY>.
AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.supportDesc: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#

AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.name: Corrupted Paju
AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.flavorText: "Why did you survive, Treyst… but I died?"
AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.effectDesc: #I can't be played# if there's another card in your hand.  #{J}# Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.supportDesc: #{D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.#

AX_Rare_CuppaSap.name: Cuppa Sap
AX_Rare_CuppaSap.flavorText: Sap beverages may not be everyone's cup of tea, but they sure perk you up!
AX_Rare_CuppaSap.effectDesc: Target Character in Reserve gains 2 boosts.

AX_Rare_DaringPorter.name: Daring Porter
AX_Rare_DaringPorter.flavorText: Someone has to shoulder the heavy burden of responsibility.
AX_Rare_DaringPorter.effectDesc: #{J}# <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Rare_DaughterofYggdrasil.name: Daughter of Yggdrasil
AX_Rare_DaughterofYggdrasil.flavorText: The children of Yggdrasil now take care of the world trees.

AX_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.name: Deep-Cloud Instructor
AX_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.flavorText: Without this suit, diving into the Tumult would be a death sentence.
AX_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.effectDesc: #{J}# You may <RUSH> a Character. If played from your hand, it activates one of its {r} abilities.  {R} I gain #1 boost.#

AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.name: Delay the Collapse
AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.flavorText: "Hold out for as long as possible. That's all that matters."
AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.effectDesc: {J} #Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.#  When you pass — If the total Hand Cost of cards in your Landmarks is {6} or more, complete me.
AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Other cards in your Landmarks are <TOUGH_1>.

AX_Rare_DemolitionExpert.name: Demolition Expert
AX_Rare_DemolitionExpert.flavorText: Mining aerolith is dangerous, but it's well worth the risk.
AX_Rare_DemolitionExpert.effectDesc: {H} Create an <AEROLITH> token in #target player's# Landmarks.  {R} You may sacrifice a Permanent #to give 1 boost to target Character.#

AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.name: Designer Drone
AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.flavorText: Designed by designers to help them design.
AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.effectDesc: #{R} You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to reduce the cost of the next Permanent you play this Afternoon by {2}.#

BR_Common_TheStew.name: The Stew
BR_Common_TheStew.flavorText: Can you guess the secret ingredient? It's seasoned with Sap.
BR_Common_TheStew.effectDesc: {J} Target Character gains 1 boost.  Characters in my Expedition are <SEASONED_CHA_P>. (They keep their boosts when they go to Reserve.)

BR_Common_Theseus.name: Theseus
BR_Common_Theseus.flavorText: For the brave souls exploring the labyrinthine depths of the city, life often hangs by the thinnest of threads.
BR_Common_Theseus.effectDesc: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} Return target Character to its owner's hand.  {R} I gain 2 boosts.

BR_Common_TinyJinn.name: Tiny Jinn
BR_Common_TinyJinn.effectDesc: If I would leave the Expedition zone while I'm <BOOSTED>, put me in my owner's Mana zone instead (as an exhausted Mana Orb).  {R} I gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_TinyJinn.flavorText: It may be a fire today — tomorrow it will be ashes.

BR_Common_TomoeGozen.name: Tomoe Gozen
BR_Common_TomoeGozen.effectDesc: I can't be played if you have less than seven Mana Orbs.
BR_Common_TomoeGozen.flavorText: For only the most gifted of Alterers could bring humanity's long-remembered legends to life.

BR_Common_WingsuitJumper.name: Wingsuit Jumper
BR_Common_WingsuitJumper.flavorText: What's important is not the landing, but the fall.
BR_Common_WingsuitJumper.effectDesc: {R} You may <RUSH> to draw a card. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Exalted_HoldtheLine.name: Hold the Line!
BR_Exalted_HoldtheLine.effectDesc: {J} Target Character gains 2 boosts.  When you pass — If you control two or more <BOOSTED_CHA_P> Characters, complete me.
BR_Exalted_HoldtheLine.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When a Companion joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.

BR_Exalted_PlagueofArrogance.name: Plague of Arrogance
BR_Exalted_PlagueofArrogance.flavorText: The only thing more dangerous than ignorance is arrogance.
BR_Exalted_PlagueofArrogance.effectDesc: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} Sacrifice a Feat to choose one, or sacrifice a <COMPLETED_LOW> Feat to choose two:  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Send target Character to Reserve.  • I gain 2 boosts.

BR_Exalted_WanaxRekaHexarch.name: Wanax, Reka Hexarch
BR_Exalted_WanaxRekaHexarch.flavorText: "I'll show you how to work without a net!"
BR_Exalted_WanaxRekaHexarch.effectDesc: Play me for {1} less per other card you played this turn.  {J} Pass. (Don't take any more turns this Day.)

BR_Rare_Achilles.name: Achilles
BR_Rare_Achilles.flavorText: "Many things lie between us—shadowy mountains and sounding sea."

BR_Rare_Aja.name: Aja
BR_Rare_Aja.flavorText: She is the soul of the forest, the patron of herbal medicine. From herbs and roots, she mixes potent potions.
BR_Rare_Aja.effectDesc: {H} Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Rare_Akhlut.name: Akhlut
BR_Rare_Akhlut.flavorText: They're deadly on land, and even deadlier in the water.
BR_Rare_Akhlut.effectDesc: When I gain 1 or more boosts — You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  #{J}# I gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_AllIn.name: All In!
BR_Rare_AllIn.flavorText: There's a time to be cautious, and a time to bet it all!
BR_Rare_AllIn.effectDesc: Roll a die. Target Character gains X boosts, where X is the result.

BR_Rare_AltrunTeammate.name: Altrun Teammate
BR_Rare_AltrunTeammate.flavorText: Altrun is a running and obstacle-dodging discipline that comes in very handy on these islands.
BR_Rare_AltrunTeammate.effectDesc: {J} You may <RUSH> to give #target Character# 1 boost. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Rare_Amarok.name: Amarok
BR_Rare_Amarok.flavorText: The lone wolf guards its territory jealously.
BR_Rare_Amarok.effectDesc: If there are no Characters in the Expedition I'm played in, I cost {2} less.  When another Character joins my Expedition — Sacrifice it #and I gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.name: Aoife, Fire Avatar
BR_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.flavorText: When the Firebird's spark ignites within you, that's when you become worthy of joining the Phoenixian Guard.
BR_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING> and gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.name: Arcolano Milk
BR_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.flavorText: Nobody knows where this "milk" actually comes from.
BR_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.effectDesc: When a Character joins my Expedition — It gains #2 boosts# and <FLEETING_CHAR>.

BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.name: Aroro, Savior of Asgartha
BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.flavorText: Alone, she was able to turn back the tide.

BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus
BR_Rare_Asmodeus.effectDesc: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain $<ANCHORED>. On a 1-3, I gain 3 boosts.

BR_Rare_Atlas.name: Atlas
BR_Rare_Atlas.flavorText: Not even the weight of the sky could make him buckle.
BR_Rare_Atlas.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 2 boosts.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_AxiomSalvager.name: Axiom Salvager
BR_Rare_AxiomSalvager.flavorText: The Axiom's limited resources pushed them to reuse whatever they could.

BR_Rare_BLISSFan.name: BLISS Fan
BR_Rare_BLISSFan.flavorText: BLISS lets the fans who bring back the most Sap come up on stage with them.
BR_Rare_BLISSFan.effectDesc: When a Character in your Reserve gains 1 or more boosts — I gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_BaronCimetiere.name: Baron Cimetière
BR_Rare_BaronCimetiere.flavorText: "Need someone to slam the gate in their faces?"
BR_Rare_BaronCimetiere.effectDesc: #{J} If you control a <COMPLETED_LOW> Feat,# create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition. #Otherwise, I gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_Belasenka.name: Belasenka
BR_Rare_Belasenka.flavorText: The cold snap they ride, like a shivering tide.

BR_Rare_Benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
BR_Rare_Benzaiten.flavorText: Good things come to those who wait.
BR_Rare_Benzaiten.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, draw a card.

BR_Rare_Beowulf.name: Beowulf

BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.name: Bold Outrider
BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.flavorText: "I've found a way! A gap just two klicks away, straight ahead!"

BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_BravosBladedancer.name: Bravos Bladedancer
BR_Rare_BravosBladedancer.flavorText: "It seems Thoth has never seen me duel."
BR_Rare_BravosBladedancer.effectDesc: $<SEASONED_ME_FS>.  {J} I gain 1 boost.  #{R} If I have 4 boosts or less, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.#

BR_Rare_BravosCloudhog.name: Bravos Cloudhog
BR_Rare_BravosCloudhog.flavorText: "Ladies and gentlemen, you are about to experience some turbulence."

BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.name: Bravos Excavator
BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.flavorText: The depths of the city are filled with archaeological marvels... along with plenty of Sap!

BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.supportDesc: #{I} When you play another Character — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.#

BR_Rare_BravosHarpooner.name: Bravos Harpooner

BR_Rare_BravosHarpooner.effectDesc: #{J}# You may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately. If you do, discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)

BR_Rare_BravosLookout.name: Bravos Lookout
BR_Rare_BravosLookout.flavorText: "I think I've found a good spot!"
BR_Rare_BravosLookout.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.#

BR_Rare_BravosPathfinder.name: Bravos Pathfinder
BR_Rare_BravosPathfinder.flavorText: "Stay on the path, they say. I make my own path!"
BR_Rare_BravosPathfinder.effectDesc: #$<SEASONED_ME_FS>.#  #{H} You may pay {2} to have me gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_BravosPendekar.name: Bravos Pendekar
BR_Rare_BravosPendekar.effectDesc: #$<SEASONED>.#  At Night — If I have 2 or more boosts, <SABOTAGE> after Rest.

BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.name: Bravos Rescuer
BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.flavorText: "Their ranks will be composed of seasoned argonauts, ready to face the perils of the unknown!"

BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character loses <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_BravosSignet.name: Bravos Signet

BR_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.name: Bravos Trailblazer

BR_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost #for each <FLEETING_CHAR> Character you control#.

BR_Rare_BravosVanguard.name: Bravos Vanguard
BR_Rare_BravosVanguard.flavorText: "We will be the arrow that pierces the veil of the unknown, the torch that banishes the mists of ignorance!"
BR_Rare_BravosVanguard.effectDesc: {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING_CHAR> #and gain 1 boost#.

BR_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.name: Burrowing Noosh

BR_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.effectDesc: #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — I gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.name: Carmela, Fast Striker

BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.effectDesc: #{J}# If you control a #<COMPLETED_LOW># Feat, #I lose <FLEETING>.#
BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.supportDesc: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Feat you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.#

BR_Rare_CatchoftheDay.name: Catch of the Day

BR_Rare_Chiron.name: Chiron

BR_Rare_Chiron.effectDesc: {J} #Up to two target Characters# each gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.name: Colorful Cuckoo
BR_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.flavorText: Even the shyest become a bit less reserved when they hear its song.

BR_Rare_CorruptedAoife.name: Corrupted Aoife
BR_Rare_CorruptedAoife.flavorText: "Are you sure you want to add fuel to the fire?"
BR_Rare_CorruptedAoife.effectDesc: #I can't be played# unless you control a Feat.  {R} You may target another Character. It loses <FLEETING> and gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.name: Corrupted Tooth Fairy
BR_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.flavorText: Why muzzle the wolf when you can remove it's fangs ?

BR_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.name: Cuddly Corgi
BR_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.flavorText: She hunts mercilessly for treats and snuggles.
BR_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.effectDesc: When a Character you control gains #<FLEETING># — I gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_CuppaSap.name: Cuppa Sap
BR_Rare_CuppaSap.flavorText: Sap beverages may not be everyone's cup of tea, but they sure perk you up!
BR_Rare_CuppaSap.effectDesc: Target Character in Reserve gains #3 boosts.#

BR_Rare_Daedalus.name: Daedalus

BR_Rare_Daedalus.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  #{J}# Target another Character #in play# or in Reserve. Then, roll a die:  • On a 4+, we both gain 1 boost.  • On a 1-3, it gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.flavorText: Without this suit, diving into the Tumult would be a death sentence.
BR_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.effectDesc: #{J}# You may <RUSH> a Character. If played from your hand, it activates one of its {r} abilities.  {R} I gain #1 boost.#

BR_Rare_DepartedBrother.name: Departed Brother
BR_Rare_DepartedBrother.flavorText: "In my memory, you're there every time I cross paths with a Leviathan." — Sol
BR_Rare_DepartedBrother.effectDesc: #When you pass first —# You may pay {1} to draw a card.

BR_Rare_DevotedProtector.effectDesc: #{R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_Dracaena.name: Dracaena
BR_Rare_Dracaena.flavorText: They're sometimes seen dozing close to a pond, soaking in the water and the sunlight...
BR_Rare_Dracaena.effectDesc: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  At Noon — I gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_DuelofGrit.name: Duel of Grit
BR_Rare_DuelofGrit.flavorText: Fiore was the first of the Seven Blades to clash with Atsadi.
BR_Rare_DuelofGrit.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  #Discard# target Character with Hand Cost less than or equal to the Hand Cost of a Character you control.

BR_Rare_Encore.name: Encore
BR_Rare_Encore.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Target <FLEETING_CHAR> #or <BOOSTED># Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.name: Enhanced Prototype
BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.flavorText: It's no longer flawed, but there's still room for improvement.

BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.supportDesc: {I} #When you play another Character# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.

BR_Rare_Eris.name: Eris
BR_Rare_Eris.flavorText: You win some, you lose some.
BR_Rare_Eris.effectDesc: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, roll a die. On a:  • 4+, it moves forward one more region instead.  #• 1, it doesn't move instead.#

BR_Rare_Eros.name: Eros
BR_Rare_Eros.flavorText: He's got more than one arrow in his quiver.
BR_Rare_Eros.effectDesc: {J} You may immediately play a Character for {3} less. #It gains 2 boosts.#

BR_Rare_FabLabUnit.name: Fab Lab Unit
BR_Rare_FabLabUnit.flavorText: All the power of the Foundry distilled into this miracle of technology.
BR_Rare_FabLabUnit.effectDesc: {T} : The next Character played from your hand in my Expedition this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.

BR_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.name: Fiore dei Liberi
BR_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.flavorText: "I am the sword, deadly against all weapons!" — Fiore
BR_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.effectDesc: If I'm <BOOSTED>, I'm $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per other Character in my Expedition, then send them all to Reserve.  At Night — I lose 1 boost.

BR_Rare_FireRabbit.name: Fire Rabbit
BR_Rare_FireRabbit.flavorText: Hot bunny in your area wants to meet!
BR_Rare_FireRabbit.effectDesc: {H} You may have me gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. If you do, another target Character gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_FireRabbit.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_FloralTent.name: Floral Tent
BR_Rare_FloralTent.flavorText: A beautiful shelter from the raging elements outside.
BR_Rare_FloralTent.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  If a #<BOOSTED> Character# would leave my Expedition during the Afternoon, #it loses all its boosts# instead.
BR_Rare_FloralTent.supportDesc: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_FlyingDockyard.name: Flying Dockyard
BR_Rare_FlyingDockyard.flavorText: "Cast off, and let the hunt begin!" - Sol
BR_Rare_FlyingDockyard.effectDesc: When you pass first — #Target Character gains 1 boost,# then create an <AEROLITH> token in #target player's# Landmarks.

BR_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.name: Flying Squirrel

BR_Rare_FoundryArmorer.name: Foundry Armorer

BR_Rare_FoundryArmorer.effectDesc: {R} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

BR_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.name: Frankenstein's Creature
BR_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.flavorText: It's by shunning differences that true monsters are born.
BR_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.effectDesc: {R} You may target #a Feat# you control. It activates its {j} abilities.

BR_Rare_Freeze.name: Freeze
BR_Rare_Freeze.effectDesc: $<COOLDOWN>.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}).

BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.name: Galvanize the Troops
BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.flavorText: "In the dead of night, we must shine the brightest!"
BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>. Then, you may have target Character you control gain <FLEETING>.  When you pass — If you control two or more <FLEETING> Characters, complete me.
BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — If you are first player, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. #Otherwise, target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_GatherthePack.name: Gather the Pack
BR_Rare_GatherthePack.flavorText: A wolf's strength is in its pack.
BR_Rare_GatherthePack.effectDesc: {J} Target Character with Base Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.  When you pass — If three or more #Characters# in your Expeditions have a different Base Cost, complete me.

BR_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.name: Gericht, Revered Duelist
BR_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.flavorText: "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger."
BR_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.effectDesc: #If I would gain <FLEETING_CHAR>, I gain 1 boost instead#.

BR_Rare_Geyser.name: Geyser
BR_Rare_Geyser.effectDesc: Return target Character or Permanent to its owner's hand, then #you may# put me in your Mana Orbs (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Rare_GuidingOcelot.name: Guiding Ocelot
BR_Rare_GuidingOcelot.flavorText: Who could be better at playing cat and mouse?
BR_Rare_GuidingOcelot.effectDesc: {J} I gain #2 boosts.#  When another Character joins your Expeditions — You may spend 1 boost #from a Character you control# to give it 1 boost.

BR_Rare_HavenBouncer.name: Haven Bouncer
BR_Rare_HavenBouncer.flavorText: Only the bravest can enter Haven.

BR_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.name: Haven, Bravos Bastion
BR_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.flavorText: Haven isn't where legends are born... it's where they live forever.
BR_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.effectDesc: #{J} $<RESUPPLY>.#  Your Characters have: \" {R} I gain 1 boost.\"

BR_Rare_HavenSeiringar.name: Haven Seiringar
BR_Rare_HavenSeiringar.flavorText: Those who have lived a lot have plenty to share.
BR_Rare_HavenSeiringar.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition Zone, if I was <FLEETING_CHAR> — Draw a card.  #{R} I gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_HavenTrainee.name: Haven Trainee

BR_Rare_HavenTrainer.name: Haven Trainer

BR_Rare_HelpfulDiver.name: Helpful Diver
