BR_Rare_Skadi.effectDesc: {R} #If I'm in {M}, <SABOTAGE>. Otherwise,# you may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

BR_Rare_SkyboundOdyssey.name: Skybound Odyssey
BR_Rare_SkyboundOdyssey.flavorText: Like a beacon, the horizon calls us onward!
BR_Rare_SkyboundOdyssey.effectDesc: Draw a card.  Both of your Expeditions <ASCEND>.  Immediately play for free up to two Characters with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)

BR_Rare_SmolderingJinn.name: Smoldering Jinn
BR_Rare_SmolderingJinn.flavorText: Fire is always smoldering in the idea of the ember.
BR_Rare_SmolderingJinn.effectDesc: {R} #You may <RUSH> to# put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone, exhausted. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Rare_SofiaFirstOutpost.name: Sofia, First Outpost
BR_Rare_SofiaFirstOutpost.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  The Support abilities of cards in Reserve can give them #counters beyond their maximum#. (Ignore "up to a max." restrictions.)

BR_Rare_SolsHunt.name: Sol's Hunt
BR_Rare_SolsHunt.flavorText: "I'll stop it before it sows death far and wide!" - Sol
BR_Rare_SolsHunt.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send target Character to Reserve.  #If you are first player,# you may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Rare_SonofNaos.name: Son of Naos
BR_Rare_SonofNaos.flavorText: Can such entities be found near all world trees?
BR_Rare_SonofNaos.effectDesc: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} #You may# target an opponent, they draw a card.  #When you make a <GIFT> — I gain 1 boost.# (A Gift is when on your turn, an opponent draws a card, Resupplies or receives a token.)

BR_Rare_SonofYggdrasil.name: Son of Yggdrasil
BR_Rare_SonofYggdrasil.flavorText: World trees like the Spindle may have grown from the seeds of the Cosmic Ash.

BR_Rare_Sow.name: Sow
BR_Rare_Sow.flavorText: The wise gardener prepares ahead of spring.
BR_Rare_Sow.supportDesc: {D} : #Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_SpiritWielder.name: Spirit Wielder
BR_Rare_SpiritWielder.flavorText: Memories of a forgotten civilization linger in those ruins. We are not alone.
BR_Rare_SpiritWielder.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost per <BOOSTED> Character you control.  #{R} I gain 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_SportsEncounter.name: Sports Encounter
BR_Rare_SportsEncounter.flavorText: "Your victory is a victory for both our peoples!"
BR_Rare_SportsEncounter.effectDesc: #$<COOLDOWN>.#  Distribute 2 boosts among any target Characters in play #or in Reserve.#

BR_Rare_SpryScout.name: Spry Scout
BR_Rare_SpryScout.flavorText: "Contact in sector 3. Try to outflank on the other side!"
BR_Rare_SpryScout.effectDesc: {R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost. #If it's <COMPLETED_LOW>, up to two target Characters each gain 1 boost instead.#

BR_Rare_SternSentinel.name: Stern Sentinel
BR_Rare_SternSentinel.flavorText: "Getting past me means going through hell—with no way back."
BR_Rare_SternSentinel.effectDesc: {H} #If you control a Feat, <SABOTAGE_LOW>.# Otherwise, <SABOTAGE_LOW> a card with Reserve Cost {2} or less.

BR_Rare_StigmaofCowardice.name: Stigma of Cowardice
BR_Rare_StigmaofCowardice.flavorText: Sometimes it's wiser to be afraid of your own shadow…
BR_Rare_StigmaofCowardice.effectDesc: #<TOUGH_1>.#  {J} Pass.  When an opponent passes — You may play a #card.# (Paying its cost normally.)

BR_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.name: Suha, Qorgan Operative
BR_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.flavorText: By accepting the Qorgan's offer, Suha got to see what was down the rabbit hole.
BR_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.effectDesc: {H} I gain #2 boosts.#  #When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — <SABOTAGE>.#

BR_Rare_SunWukong.name: Sun Wukong
BR_Rare_SunWukong.flavorText: Ever the trickster, always the rebel.

BR_Rare_Sustenance.name: Sustenance
BR_Rare_Sustenance.flavorText: Anything goes when there are empty bellies to be filled.
BR_Rare_Sustenance.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Draw a card.  Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Rare_SwiftJinn.name: Swift Jinn
BR_Rare_SwiftJinn.flavorText: The quickest solution when you need extra firepower.
BR_Rare_SwiftJinn.effectDesc: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone as a #ready# Mana Orb.

BR_Rare_TalarianSkater.name: Talarian Skater
BR_Rare_TalarianSkater.flavorText: To explore the City, adventurers need daily deliveries from the surface.
BR_Rare_TalarianSkater.effectDesc: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  {J} Target Character in play #or in Reserve# gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_Tane.name: Tāne
BR_Rare_Tane.flavorText: Firmly rooted like a tree, yet free like the birds, he embodies nature's strength.
BR_Rare_Tane.effectDesc: #<TOUGH_1>.# (Opponents must pay {1} to target me.)  {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  {J} Each Animal #and Adventurer# in your Reserve gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_TechnicalBoots.name: Technical Boots
BR_Rare_TechnicalBoots.effectDesc: #{R} $<RESUPPLY>.#  When my Expedition moves forward — Target Character in my Expedition loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

BR_Rare_Tengu.name: Tengu
BR_Rare_Tengu.flavorText: "Calling the Tengu means submitting to anger and vanity, no?" - Basira
BR_Rare_Tengu.effectDesc: #{J} You may <RUSH>. If you do, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.# (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Rare_TheCouncil.name: The Council
BR_Rare_TheCouncil.flavorText: The idea of facing the Council is deterrent enough for most would-be criminals in Asgartha.
BR_Rare_TheCouncil.effectDesc: The {j}, {h} and {r} abilities of Characters facing me can't activate.

BR_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.name: The Foundry, Axiom Bastion
BR_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.flavorText: Embedded in the cliff wall, it overlooks the city and reminds everyone who looks up at it that nothing is unreachable if you put your mind to it.
BR_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.effectDesc: {T} : The next Character you play from your hand this turn activates its {r} abilities (as if it had been played from Reserve).

BR_Rare_TheGrems.name: The Grems
BR_Rare_TheGrems.flavorText: It's not demolition, but basic recycling. Or so they say.
BR_Rare_TheGrems.effectDesc: {R} Choose up to one:  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.  • Sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

BR_Rare_TheHare.name: The Hare
BR_Rare_TheHare.effectDesc: {H} If you are first player, target player becomes first player.

BR_Rare_TheHatter.name: The Hatter
BR_Rare_TheHatter.flavorText: "You can draw water out of a water-well, so I should think you could draw treacle out of a treacle-well — eh, stupid ?"
BR_Rare_TheHatter.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_TheHunger.name: The Hunger
BR_Rare_TheHunger.flavorText: The City has a soul, and it is famished.
BR_Rare_TheHunger.effectDesc: {H} Discard all other cards in play or in Reserve.  When a card goes to the discard pile — I gain 1 boost.  #If I'm <FLEETING>, I am <GIGANTIC>.#

BR_Rare_TheLastStand.name: The Last Stand
BR_Rare_TheLastStand.flavorText: "If we are to fall, let this be our last stand!"
BR_Rare_TheLastStand.effectDesc: {J} Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less.#  When you pass — If you control another Feat, complete me.

BR_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.name: The Little Match Girl
BR_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.flavorText: When you're alone in the cold, even the tiniest light can feel like salvation.
BR_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.effectDesc: {R} If your hand is empty, draw a card.

BR_Rare_TheMagicSleigh.name: The Magic Sleigh
BR_Rare_TheMagicSleigh.effectDesc: #{J} I gain <FLEETING_CHAR>.#  If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, it moves twice instead.

BR_Rare_TheMess.name: The Mess
BR_Rare_TheMess.flavorText: Every evening, the Mess overflows with laughter and shouting as explorers share their daily exploits.
BR_Rare_TheMess.effectDesc: When a #non-token# Character leaves your Expeditions — I gain 1 Food counter.  {T}, #Spend 4# of my Food counters: #draw a card.#

BR_Rare_ThePainthouse.name: The Painthouse
BR_Rare_ThePainthouse.flavorText: The paints of the Tisdhera still perfume the heights of the Wayfarer.
BR_Rare_ThePainthouse.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  At Noon — If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, you may give 1 boost to target Character in Reserve.

BR_Rare_TheShell.name: The Shell
BR_Rare_TheShell.effectDesc: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to draw a card.

BR_Rare_TheSnowman.name: The Snowman
BR_Rare_TheSnowman.flavorText: Which will melt first: him, or your heart?
BR_Rare_TheSnowman.supportDesc: #{D} : <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.name: The Spindle, Muna Bastion
BR_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.effectDesc: Characters you control have $<TOUGH_2>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
BR_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.flavorText: Within the Spindle's trunk is the Bark Refuge, the sanctuary where the Muna converse with sentient plants.

BR_Rare_TheStew.name: The Stew
BR_Rare_TheStew.flavorText: Can you guess the secret ingredient? It's seasoned with Sap.
BR_Rare_TheStew.effectDesc: {J}# You may pay {1}# to have target Character gain 1 boost #or lose <FLEETING>.#  Characters in my Expedition are <SEASONED_CHA_P>. (They keep their boosts when they go to Reserve.)

BR_Rare_Theseus.name: Theseus
BR_Rare_Theseus.flavorText: For the brave souls exploring the labyrinthine depths of the city, life often hangs by the thinnest of threads.
BR_Rare_Theseus.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_4> {4}.#  {J} Send target Character #to Reserve.#  {R} I gain #3 boosts.#

BR_Rare_ThomasEdison.name: Thomas Edison
BR_Rare_ThomasEdison.flavorText: "Thanks to MY new invention, the city is safe!"
BR_Rare_ThomasEdison.effectDesc: {J} You may discard #up to two# Characters from your Reserve. If you do, I activate #up to two# of their {r} abilities as if they were mine.

BR_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.name: Three Little Pigs
BR_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.flavorText: Together they can build more than just a stone house.
BR_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.effectDesc: {J} If you control #one or more# Landmarks, I gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_TimeOut.name: Time Out!
BR_Rare_TimeOut.flavorText: Time to switch things up a bit.
BR_Rare_TimeOut.effectDesc: Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {4} or less, then exhaust it ({T}). (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)  Then, I gain <FLEETING> #unless there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve.#

BR_Rare_TinyJail.name: Tiny Jail
BR_Rare_TinyJail.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with no statistic over 3.

BR_Rare_TinyJinn.name: Tiny Jinn
BR_Rare_TinyJinn.flavorText: It may be a fire today — tomorrow it will be ashes.
BR_Rare_TinyJinn.effectDesc: If I would leave the Expedition zone while I'm <BOOSTED>, put me in my owner's Mana zone instead (as an exhausted Mana Orb).  {R} I gain 1 boost.

BR_Rare_TomoeGozen.name: Tomoe Gozen
BR_Rare_TomoeGozen.flavorText: For only the most gifted of Alterers could bring humanity's long-remembered legends to life.
BR_Rare_TomoeGozen.effectDesc: I can't be played if you have less than #six Mana Orbs#.

BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.name: Twinkle Twinkle
BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.flavorText: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.
BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.effectDesc: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.supportDesc: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

BR_Rare_Valemon.name: Valemon
BR_Rare_Valemon.flavorText: Promise me to wait, and I will show you my real face.
BR_Rare_Valemon.effectDesc: Unless you have eight or more Mana Orbs, I am $<DEFENDER>.  #If you have ten or more Mana Orbs, I am $<GIGANTIC>.#

BR_Rare_WildlifeMedic.name: Wildlife Medic
BR_Rare_WildlifeMedic.flavorText: Basira’s husband has been called back to treat the wounded animals.
BR_Rare_WildlifeMedic.effectDesc: {H} <RESUPPLY>. If you put #a Character# in Reserve this way, it gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.name: Wingsuit Jumper
BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.flavorText: What's important is not the landing, but the fall.
BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.effectDesc: #{H}# You may <RUSH> to draw a card. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#

BR_Rare_WoollyWoollyField.name: Woolly Woolly Field
BR_Rare_WoollyWoollyField.effectDesc: {T} : Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target opponent's Companion Expedition. The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.name: Yanna, Qorgan Agent
BR_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.flavorText: Spies from the Qorgan infiltrate the Factions and steal their secrets.
BR_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.effectDesc: {J} You may have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. #If it's facing me, <SABOTAGE>.#

BR_Rare_Yeti.name: Yeti
BR_Rare_Yeti.effectDesc: {H} #You may have me# gain $<ASLEEP>.  When another Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_YzmirSignet.name: Yzmir Signet
BR_Rare_YzmirSignet.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Draw a card.

LY_Common_ACappellaTraining.name: A Cappella Training
LY_Common_ACappellaTraining.effectDesc: Target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
LY_Common_ACappellaTraining.flavorText: Thank you for being my metronome!

LY_Common_AllIn.name: All In!
LY_Common_AllIn.effectDesc: Roll a die. Target Character gains X boosts$<BB>, where X is the result.
LY_Common_AllIn.flavorText: There's a time to be cautious, and a time to bet it all!

LY_Common_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.name: Amahle, Asgarthan Outcast
LY_Common_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.effectDesc: {J} You may discard a card from your Reserve to draw a card.
LY_Common_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.flavorText: The old world is dying, and the new world struggles to be born: now is the time of monsters.

LY_Common_Anansi.name: Anansi
LY_Common_Anansi.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost$<BB> for each card in your Reserve.
LY_Common_Anansi.flavorText: In the end, he had accumulated pretty well all the wisdom that was available. He put it in a gourd and made a stopper for it.

LY_Common_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus
LY_Common_Asmodeus.effectDesc: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain $<ANCHORED>. On a 1-3, I gain 3 boosts$<BB>.

LY_Common_AuraqKibble.name: Auraq & Kibble
LY_Common_AuraqKibble.flavorText: True beauty lies outside of the conventional.
LY_Common_AuraqKibble.effectDesc: When you play a Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain a Performance counter.  At Noon — You may spend five of my Performance counters to reveal the top card of your deck. You may play it for free or put it into your hand. (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)

LY_Common_BLISSBassist.name: BLISS Bassist
LY_Common_BLISSBassist.flavorText: "This one's for all the explorers out there and all the hard work they do. They're not just monkeyin' around!" — Boona
LY_Common_BLISSBassist.supportDesc: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.name: BLISS Drummer
LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.flavorText: "Throw your hands up in the air for everyone who's hauling out those amazing relics from the City of Scholars!" — Tamati
LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.effectDesc: If I'm <BOOSTED>, other Characters cost {1} less to play from your Reserve, with a minimum of {1}.
LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.supportDesc: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

LY_Common_BLISSFan.name: BLISS Fan
LY_Common_BLISSFan.flavorText: BLISS lets the fans who bring back the most Sap come up on stage with them.
LY_Common_BLISSFan.effectDesc: When a Character in your Reserve gains 1 or more boosts — I gain 1 boost.

LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.name: BLISS Keytarist
LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.flavorText: "Make some noise for all the brave folks pulling Sap up from the depths!" — Orbec
LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.effectDesc: At Dusk — If I'm <BOOSTED>, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Character with a base statistic of 0, draw it. Otherwise, discard it.
LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.supportDesc: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

LY_Common_Bastet.name: Bastet
LY_Common_Bastet.effectDesc: (An Anchored Character doesn't go to Reserve during Rest and loses Anchored.)
LY_Common_Bastet.supportDesc: {D} : The next Character with Base Cost {3} or less you play this turn gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_BestowingSloth.name: Bestowing Sloth
LY_Common_BestowingSloth.flavorText: "I'm not lazy, I'm just conserving energy."
LY_Common_BestowingSloth.supportDesc: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (End your turn as if you had played a card.)

LY_Common_BreaktheIce.name: Break the Ice
LY_Common_BreaktheIce.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  I cost {2} less if you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_CableCarStation.name: Cable-Car Station
LY_Common_CableCarStation.flavorText: Reka cable-cars are the safest way to get around the city.
LY_Common_CableCarStation.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>, then I gain 2 Move counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Move counters: One of your Expeditions moves backwards one region. If it does, your other Expedition moves forward one region.

LY_Common_Carbunclo.name: Carbunclo
LY_Common_Carbunclo.flavorText: Is that a ruby on its forehead or a burning lump of coal ?
LY_Common_Carbunclo.effectDesc: {H} If a card in your Expeditions or your Reserve has a {D} ability, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)

LY_Common_CatsCradle.name: Cat's Cradle
LY_Common_CatsCradle.flavorText: "Time to let the cat out of the bag!"
LY_Common_CatsCradle.effectDesc: Target Character with Base Cost {3} or less switches Expeditions, then gains <ANCHORED>. (Switch means joining the other Expedition of its controller.)

LY_Common_CheshireCat.name: Cheshire Cat
LY_Common_CheshireCat.effectDesc: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may have target Character switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition. I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Common_Cleanse.name: Cleanse
LY_Common_Cleanse.flavorText: "What do you think of my smoldering eyes?"
LY_Common_Cleanse.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Roll a die. You may send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {X} or less, where X is the result. (Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

LY_Common_ClothCocoon.name: Cloth Cocoon
LY_Common_ClothCocoon.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <FLEETING_CHAR>, <ANCHORED> or <ASLEEP> Character.  • Discard target Permanent.

LY_Common_CorruptedEsmeralda.name: Corrupted Esmeralda
LY_Common_CorruptedEsmeralda.flavorText: \"Are you sure you want to follow me into hell, Fen ?\"
LY_Common_CorruptedEsmeralda.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless a {D} ability was activated this turn.  {H} <RESUPPLY>.

LY_Common_Daedalus.name: Daedalus
LY_Common_Daedalus.flavorText: No one is truly lost, for all are exactly where fate wants them to be.
LY_Common_Daedalus.effectDesc: {H} Target a Character in Reserve. Then, roll a die:  • On a 4+, we both gain 1 boost.  • On a 1-3, it gains 1 boost.

LY_Common_Daikokuten.name: Daikokuten
LY_Common_Daikokuten.flavorText: If you never take a risk, you'll never be rewarded.
LY_Common_Daikokuten.effectDesc: {J} Target opponent may immediately play a Spell for free.

LY_Common_DioclesChariotRacer.name: Diocles, Chariot Racer
LY_Common_DioclesChariotRacer.flavorText: "Hop in, it's a guaranteed five-star experience!"
LY_Common_DioclesChariotRacer.effectDesc: I can't be played in a starting region.  {J} My Expedition moves backwards one region.  When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition moves forward one region.

LY_Common_DonJuan.name: Don Juan
LY_Common_DonJuan.effectDesc: If I would go to Reserve from the Expedition zone, I gain <FLEETING> and defect instead. (I join the Expedition facing me, changing controllers. If I would go to any personal zone, I go to my owner's instead.)

LY_Common_EfrenPuppetMaster.name: Efrén, Puppet Master
LY_Common_EfrenPuppetMaster.flavorText: "I could never let the winding threads of fate separate me from my daughter." — Efrén
LY_Common_EfrenPuppetMaster.effectDesc: {H} Roll a die:  • On a 4+, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)  • On a 1-3, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)

LY_Common_Encore.name: Encore
LY_Common_Encore.effectDesc: Target <FLEETING_CHAR> Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

LY_Common_Eris.name: Eris
LY_Common_Eris.flavorText: You win some, you lose some.
LY_Common_Eris.effectDesc: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, roll a die. On a 4+: it moves forward one more region instead.

LY_Common_Esmeralda.name: Esmeralda
LY_Common_Esmeralda.flavorText: Eidolon or not, you are our Shepherdess. You lead and we follow.

LY_Common_FenCrowbar.name: Fen & Crowbar
LY_Common_FenCrowbar.flavorText: When you listen to the voice of the Wind, it always carries you where you're meant to be.
LY_Common_FenCrowbar.effectDesc: During Morning, draw only one card. Then, put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone instead of a card from your hand.  At Noon — $<RESUPPLY>.  Ignore my abilities during the first Day.

LY_Common_ForestNymph.name: Forest Nymph
LY_Common_ForestNymph.flavorText: From an innocent seed, she creates wild forests.
LY_Common_ForestNymph.effectDesc: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {V}, you may have target Character gain <FLEETING>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)

LY_Common_FragrantMeerkat.name: Fragrant Meerkat
LY_Common_FragrantMeerkat.flavorText: Do you smell a rat ? Nope, that's just me!

LY_Common_Hathor.name: Hathor
LY_Common_Hathor.supportDesc: {D} : Return another card from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_Hathor.flavorText: Dance is the language of the soul.

LY_Common_Heimdall.name: Heimdall
LY_Common_Heimdall.flavorText: Proud guardian of the Bifröst, he decides who gets to switch sides.
LY_Common_Heimdall.effectDesc: {H} You may have target Character switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

LY_Common_HostelNightkeeper.name: Hostel Nightkeeper
LY_Common_HostelNightkeeper.flavorText: "Floor -2, room 217. Welcome to the Underlook Hostel."
LY_Common_HostelNightkeeper.effectDesc: {H} You may target a Character. If you do, it gains <ASLEEP>, then create a <MANASEED> token in its controller's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

LY_Common_IceboundTundra.name: Icebound Tundra
LY_Common_IceboundTundra.flavorText: We can hear it, echoing in the vast expanses.
LY_Common_IceboundTundra.effectDesc: When you play a Character in a region type where its base statistic is 0 — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then return a card from your Reserve to your hand.

LY_Common_Joyride.name: Joyride
LY_Common_Joyride.flavorText: Everything fun is life is either forbidden or completely crazy.
LY_Common_Joyride.effectDesc: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Discard another card from your Reserve. If you do, target Character gains 2 boosts.

LY_Common_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.name: Koi, Playful Leviathan
LY_Common_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.flavorText: Its gracious leap parted the clouds, revealing our path forward.

LY_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
LY_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effectDesc: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_Lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
LY_Common_Lakshmi.flavorText: Fortune smiles on those who give themselves over to it.
LY_Common_Lakshmi.effectDesc: When you roll one or more dice — I gain 1 boost.

LY_Common_LakshmisOwl.name: Lakshmi's Owl
LY_Common_LakshmisOwl.flavorText: Even in the blackest night, I can see light.
LY_Common_LakshmisOwl.effectDesc: When you roll one or more dice — If I have no boosts, you may give me 1 boost and <FLEETING_CHAR> .

LY_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
LY_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effectDesc: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

LY_Common_Loki.name: Loki
LY_Common_Loki.effectDesc: {H} Each player discards their hand, then draws three cards.

LY_Common_LostintheRiptide.name: Lost in the Riptide
LY_Common_LostintheRiptide.flavorText: This is why you're supposed to read the map...
LY_Common_LostintheRiptide.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  You may play me for {1} less. If you do, I can only target a Character in {O}.  Return target Character to the top of its owner's deck.

LY_Common_LyraAerialist.name: Lyra Aerialist
LY_Common_LyraAerialist.flavorText: The Cloth Dancers' great talent is to use every rough spot to adapt to their environment.

LY_Common_LyraChronicler.name: Lyra Chronicler
LY_Common_LyraChronicler.flavorText: Eidolon or human, we are all shaped by stories. They're the building blocks of our identity.

LY_Common_LyraClothDancer.name: Lyra Cloth Dancer
LY_Common_LyraClothDancer.effectDesc: {H} Up to one target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
LY_Common_LyraClothDancer.flavorText: Hope you're not afraid of heights!

LY_Common_LyraContortionist.name: Lyra Contortionist
LY_Common_LyraContortionist.flavorText: The Lyra from the Tisdhera clan will bend over backwards for their community.
LY_Common_LyraContortionist.supportDesc: {I} I don't count towards your Reserve limit.

LY_Common_LyraDJ.name: Lyra DJ
LY_Common_LyraDJ.flavorText: There's something a bit unusual about this set…
LY_Common_LyraDJ.effectDesc: You may play me for {2} less in an Expedition that's <IN_CONTACT>. (It's In Contact if there is another player's Expedition in its region.)

LY_Common_LyraFestival.name: Lyra Festival
LY_Common_LyraFestival.effectDesc: {J} Draw a card.  At Dusk, if you control a <FLEETING> Character, another <ANCHORED> Character and yet another <ASLEEP> Character — You win the game.
LY_Common_LyraFestival.flavorText: When the time of the Kalann Mae comes, the Lyra all feel the call to a single place, where they will bring a masterpiece to life.

LY_Common_LyraFifer.name: Lyra Fifer
LY_Common_LyraFifer.flavorText: Don't they say that he who pays the piper calls the tune?
LY_Common_LyraFifer.effectDesc: {J} If a card in your Expeditions or your Reserve has a {D} ability, I gain 1 boost $<BB>.

LY_Common_LyraMapmaker.name: Lyra Mapmaker
LY_Common_LyraMapmaker.flavorText: When the map covers the whole landscape, which one is more real?
LY_Common_LyraMapmaker.effectDesc: {J} If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, I gain 1 boost.

LY_Common_LyraNavigator.name: Lyra Navigator
LY_Common_LyraNavigator.flavorText: Like the Bravos, Lyras are drawn to freedom and the distant horizon.

LY_Common_LyraSignet.name: Lyra Signet
LY_Common_LyraSignet.effectDesc: Choose one:  • Up to two target Characters gain <FLEETING>.  • Draw a card, then roll a die. On a 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • Target Character gains 1 boost per card in your Reserve.

LY_Common_LyraSkald.name: Lyra Skald
LY_Common_LyraSkald.flavorText: We're all stories, in the end.

LY_Common_LyraThespian.name: Lyra Thespian
LY_Common_LyraThespian.effectDesc: {J} If you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control, I gain 1 boost$<BB>.

LY_Common_MagpengHoarder.name: Magpeng Hoarder
LY_Common_MagpengHoarder.flavorText: Why does it need all these? Might come in handy someday!
LY_Common_MagpengHoarder.effectDesc: {J} If you have two or more cards in Reserve, I gain 1 boost and $<FLEETING_CHAR>.

LY_Common_ManintheMaze.name: Man in the Maze
LY_Common_ManintheMaze.flavorText: Life is a maze, but our purpose is not to escape it. The purpose of life is the maze itself.
LY_Common_ManintheMaze.effectDesc: {H} Remove all boosts from Characters in play and in Reserve. Then, depending on the number of boosts removed this way:  • 1-4: I gain 2 boosts.  • 5-8: Play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.  • 9+: My Expedition moves forward one region.

LY_Common_MapmakersBoon.name: Mapmaker's Boon
LY_Common_MapmakersBoon.flavorText: Each of us paints their own reality.
LY_Common_MapmakersBoon.effectDesc: If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, target Character gains 4 boosts. Otherwise, it gains 2 boosts.

LY_Common_Martengale.name: Martengale
LY_Common_Martengale.supportDesc: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_Martengale.flavorText: Spotting a martengale is always a good omen.

LY_Common_MerryReunion.name: Merry Reunion
LY_Common_MerryReunion.effectDesc: $<RESUPPLY>. If you put a Character in Reserve this way, you may immediately play it for {2} less.

LY_Common_MiaPrimaBallerina.name: Mia, Prima Ballerina
LY_Common_MiaPrimaBallerina.flavorText: The former Matriarch of the Kasirga clan leads the dance, however macabre it may be.
LY_Common_MiaPrimaBallerina.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character gains <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_MindApotheosis.name: Mind Apotheosis
LY_Common_MindApotheosis.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Reveal the top four cards of your Deck. Choose up to two Characters from these cards and put them in your Expeditions. They gain <FLEETING>. Discard the other cards. (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)
LY_Common_MindApotheosis.flavorText: Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.

LY_Common_MountainGuide.name: Mountain Guide
LY_Common_MountainGuide.flavorText: Who better than a groundhog to wind their way through these hanging rice fields?

LY_Common_MountainNymph.name: Mountain Nymph
LY_Common_MountainNymph.flavorText: From a mere pebble, she creates a sparkling jewel.
LY_Common_MountainNymph.effectDesc: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {M}, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

LY_Common_NadirBubbles.name: Nadir & Bubbles
LY_Common_NadirBubbles.effectDesc: I begin the game with one {V}, one {M} and one {O} Terrain Marker.  At Noon — You may place one of my Markers on target visible region. (It gains the terrain of the Marker and loses its other terrains until the Marker is removed.)

LY_Common_NevenkaBlotch.name: Nevenka & Blotch
LY_Common_NevenkaBlotch.effectDesc: {T} : Target a Character you control, then roll a die. On a:  • 6+, it gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)  • 2-5, it gains 1 boost$<BB>.  • 1, send it to Reserve.
LY_Common_NevenkaBlotch.flavorText: Chaos can bring disappointment, sure, but it's also where ye'll find the most wonderfullest hidden gems!

LY_Common_NightclubBouncer.name: Nightclub Bouncer
LY_Common_NightclubBouncer.flavorText: "What part of 'dress code' do you not understand?"
LY_Common_NightclubBouncer.effectDesc: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Common_Nisse.name: Nisse
LY_Common_Nisse.flavorText: "You never know what you'll find in your stockings."
LY_Common_Nisse.effectDesc: {H} Roll a die. On a:  • 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • 1-3, <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_Nuit.name: Nuit
LY_Common_Nuit.flavorText: Gone is the sun, and again comes the night.
LY_Common_Nuit.effectDesc: {H} If there are nine or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control and in your Reserve, each player passes. (Starting with you, they end their Afternoon and don't take any more turns this Day.)

LY_Common_NyalaGiftedConjurer.name: Nyala, Gifted Conjurer
LY_Common_NyalaGiftedConjurer.flavorText: "Of course I'm cheating. That's what magic is all about."
LY_Common_NyalaGiftedConjurer.effectDesc: {J} Exchange target card from your Reserve with a card from your Hand.

LY_Common_NyalaNightReveler.name: Nyala, Night Reveler
LY_Common_NyalaNightReveler.flavorText: "I can get in anywhere, VIP list or not."
LY_Common_NyalaNightReveler.effectDesc: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may exchange a card from your Reserve with a card from your hand. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Common_OuroborosCroupier.name: Ouroboros Croupier
LY_Common_OuroborosCroupier.effectDesc: {H} Roll a die. On a 4+, draw a card. On a 1-3, $<RESUPPLY_LOW>.

LY_Common_OuroborosInkcaster.name: Ouroboros Inkcaster
LY_Common_OuroborosInkcaster.effectDesc: When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — You may return another card from your Reserve to your hand.
LY_Common_OuroborosInkcaster.flavorText: When luck joins in the game, cleverness scores double.

LY_Common_OuroborosTrickster.name: Ouroboros Trickster
LY_Common_OuroborosTrickster.effectDesc: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain 2 boosts. On a 1-3, I gain 1 boost$<BB>.
LY_Common_OuroborosTrickster.flavorText: When luck joins in the game, cleverness scores double.

LY_Common_PaintPrison.name: Paint Prison
LY_Common_PaintPrison.flavorText: Your problem is a lack of perspective.
LY_Common_PaintPrison.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  You may discard a card from your Reserve to reduce my cost by {2}.  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.

LY_Common_PaintitPink.name: Paint it Pink!
LY_Common_PaintitPink.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less if one or more of your Expeditions are <IN_CONTACT>. (If another player's Expedition is in their region.)  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.

LY_Common_Pinocchio.name: Pinocchio
LY_Common_Pinocchio.flavorText: After that, he'll sleep like a log, and that's no lie.

LY_Common_RekaBarmaid.name: Reka Barmaid
LY_Common_RekaBarmaid.flavorText: "It's happy hour all the time here!"
LY_Common_RekaBarmaid.effectDesc: At Dusk — If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 1 boost. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Common_RekaGuide.name: Reka Guide
LY_Common_RekaGuide.flavorText: "Let's wrap up today's visit with a taste of some local specialties."
LY_Common_RekaGuide.supportDesc: {D} : Return another Character from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_RekaHeadset.name: Reka Headset
LY_Common_RekaHeadset.flavorText: This way, we're all on the same wavelength.
LY_Common_RekaHeadset.effectDesc: My Expedition and its Characters are considered <IN_CONTACT>. (Even if there are no other Expeditions in my region.)  {T} : The next Character that joins my Expedition this turn gains 1 boost.

LY_Common_RekaRopedancer.name: Reka Ropedancer
LY_Common_RekaRopedancer.supportDesc: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost and <ASLEEP>.

LY_Common_RekaThurifer.name: Reka Thurifer
LY_Common_RekaThurifer.flavorText: Through drifting incense, we purge the darkness within.
LY_Common_RekaThurifer.supportDesc: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_RekaZipliner.name: Reka Zipliner
LY_Common_RekaZipliner.flavorText: The shortest distance between two points is a straight line.

LY_Common_RidetheBifrost.name: Ride the Bifröst
LY_Common_RidetheBifrost.flavorText: The Lyra never play by the rules.
LY_Common_RidetheBifrost.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  All Characters you control switch Expeditions. (They leave their Expeditions and join their controller's other Expedition.)

LY_Common_RomanticEncounter.name: Romantic Encounter
LY_Common_RomanticEncounter.flavorText: "I've never felt this close to anyone."
LY_Common_RomanticEncounter.effectDesc: Target opponent reveals the top four cards of their deck. You may play a Character from these cards for free and it gains <FLEETING>, then discard the rest. (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)

LY_Common_SantaClaus.name: Santa Claus
LY_Common_SantaClaus.effectDesc: {H} Starting with you, each player may immediately play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.

LY_Common_SapDuende.name: Sap Duende
LY_Common_SapDuende.flavorText: When the rhythm picks up, the strings release the Sap covering them.
LY_Common_SapDuende.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Target two <BOOSTED_CHA_P> Characters in play or in Reserve and exchange their boosts.  Draw a card.

LY_Common_SeaNymph.name: Sea Nymph
LY_Common_SeaNymph.flavorText: From a thin trickle of water, she creates raging tides.
LY_Common_SeaNymph.effectDesc: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {O}, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)

LY_Common_SilentNight.name: Silent Night
LY_Common_SilentNight.flavorText: All is calm, all is bright.
LY_Common_SilentNight.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Target a Character, then roll a die. On a:  • 4+, it gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)  • 1-3, it gains <ASLEEP>. (Ignore its statistics during Dusk. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)

LY_Common_SleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
LY_Common_SleightofHand.flavorText: "An old trick well done is far better than a new trick with no effect." - Houdini
LY_Common_SleightofHand.effectDesc: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Exchange target Character in your Reserve with a card from your Hand.

LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.name: Smoke Them Out
LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.flavorText: "Where there's smoke, there's fire… and we're proof of that!"
LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  When two {D} abilities are activated on one of your turns — Complete me.
LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: {T} : The next time a {D} ability is activated this turn, target Character gains 1 boost.

LY_Common_SmokingSkunk.name: Smoking Skunk
LY_Common_SmokingSkunk.flavorText: With certain opponents, you can litterally smell the danger.
LY_Common_SmokingSkunk.supportDesc: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_SnowballCommando.name: Snowball Commando
LY_Common_SnowballCommando.effectDesc: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in an opponent's Reserve, then roll a die. When you roll a 1-3 this way — That opponent targets a card in your Reserve. Exhaust it. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_StickyShroom.name: Sticky Shroom
LY_Common_StickyShroom.flavorText: He's a fun guy, but he can get into some sticky situations.

LY_Common_StigmaofHavoc.name: Stigma of Havoc
LY_Common_StigmaofHavoc.effectDesc: {H} Each player discards their Reserve, <RESUPPLIES>, then <RESUPPLIES> again.
LY_Common_StigmaofHavoc.supportDesc: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_TheHatter.name: The Hatter
LY_Common_TheHatter.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_TheHatter.flavorText: "You can draw water out of a water-well, so I should think you could draw treacle out of a treacle-well — eh, stupid ?"

LY_Common_TheMagicSleigh.name: The Magic Sleigh
LY_Common_TheMagicSleigh.effectDesc: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, it moves twice instead.

LY_Common_TheOperaHouse.name: The Opera House
LY_Common_TheOperaHouse.flavorText: The Arkaster Opera House is known as the Spark, for that's where stars are born.
LY_Common_TheOperaHouse.effectDesc: {T} : Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Spell, draw it. (Otherwise, leave it on top of your deck.)

LY_Common_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.name: The Ouroboros, Lyra Bastion
LY_Common_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.flavorText: The Expeditionary Corps' mobile outpost soars high, like a spinning wheel weaving the wind.
LY_Common_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.effectDesc: If you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the roll of your choice.

LY_Common_ThePainthouse.name: The Painthouse
LY_Common_ThePainthouse.flavorText: The paints of the Tisdhera still perfume the heights of the Wayfarer.
LY_Common_ThePainthouse.effectDesc: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  At Noon — If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, you may give 1 boost to target Character in Reserve.

LY_Common_TheSandman.name: The Sandman
LY_Common_TheSandman.effectDesc: {H} Up to one target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
LY_Common_TheSandman.flavorText: "Sand gives you a taste of what life is all about. Come morning, the castles you have built will be gone with the tide."

LY_Common_TheSnowman.name: The Snowman
LY_Common_TheSnowman.flavorText: Which will melt first: him, or your heart?

LY_Common_TheStage.name: The Stage
LY_Common_TheStage.flavorText: Day or night, the music of BLISS reinvigorates weary hearts and bodies.
LY_Common_TheStage.effectDesc: When you play a Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 Performance counter.  {T}, Spend 3 of my Performance counters: the next Character with a base statistic of 0 that you play this turn loses <FLEETING>.

LY_Common_TheWayfarer.name: The Wayfarer
LY_Common_TheWayfarer.flavorText: The Tisdhera Clan answers its Matriarch's call!
LY_Common_TheWayfarer.effectDesc: If you would roll one or more dice, also reveal the top card of your deck.  When you reveal a card this way — If its Hand Cost is equal to the die's result, draw it.

LY_Common_TheWesternWind.name: The Western Wind
LY_Common_TheWesternWind.flavorText: It's no use going against the Wind.
LY_Common_TheWesternWind.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Target Expedition moves backwards one region. If it does, its controller moves their other Expedition forward one region.

LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.name: Twinkle Twinkle
LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.effectDesc: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.supportDesc: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.flavorText: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.

LY_Common_UrbexSpecialist.name: Urbex Specialist
LY_Common_UrbexSpecialist.flavorText: Exploration is always fun with the right company!
LY_Common_UrbexSpecialist.effectDesc: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, my {V}, {M} and {O} are equal to my highest statistic. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Common_WillotheWisp.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
LY_Common_WillotheWisp.flavorText: "Nine fathom deep he had followed us - From the land of mist and snow."
LY_Common_WillotheWisp.effectDesc: If an Expedition facing me is in {O}, it can’t move forward during Dusk, except due to {O}.
LY_Common_WillotheWisp.supportDesc: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_WinterOutfits.name: Winter Outfits
LY_Common_WinterOutfits.flavorText: There's no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothing.
LY_Common_WinterOutfits.effectDesc: Characters in my Expedition have their {V}, {M}, and {O} equal to their highest statistic.

LY_Common_XMarkstheSpot.name: X Marks the Spot
LY_Common_XMarkstheSpot.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Roll a die. Send target Character to the Xth position of its owner's deck, where X is the result.

LY_Common_YeongGiEmber.name: Yeong-Gi & Ember
LY_Common_YeongGiEmber.effectDesc: {T} : Roll a die, then spend any number of my Luck counters to increase the result by that much. On a:  • 4+, You may target a Character in your Expeditions. It activates its {D} ability.  • 1-3: I gain a Luck counter.

args.desc: Target a card for Yeong-Gi & Ember effect

LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.name: Give Fate a Twist!
LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.flavorText: Even fate appreciates a helping hand!
LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.effectDesc: {J} Roll a die. On a 1: Play another turn.  When you roll a 6+ on a die — Complete me.
LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: If you would roll a die, you may exhaust me ({T}) to add 1 to its result. (Choose after you see the result.)

LY_Exalted_PhoibosRekaHexarch.name: Phoibos, Reka Hexarch
LY_Exalted_PhoibosRekaHexarch.flavorText: "I'm never more comfortable than when I'm in the spotlight."
LY_Exalted_PhoibosRekaHexarch.effectDesc: {H} Target opponent reveals a random card from their hand. If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may immediately play it for free and it gains <FLEETING>. If you don't, discard it.

LY_Exalted_PlagueofDespair.name: Plague of Despair
LY_Exalted_PlagueofDespair.flavorText: "The soul does not give itself up to despair until it has exhausted all illusions." – Victor Hugo
LY_Exalted_PlagueofDespair.effectDesc: <GIGANTIC>.  When you roll a 6+ on a die — I gain 1 boost.  When you roll a 1 on a die — Send me to Reserve.

LY_Rare_ACappellaTraining.name: A Cappella Training
LY_Rare_ACappellaTraining.flavorText: Thank you for being my metronome!
LY_Rare_ACappellaTraining.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)  #Draw a card.#

LY_Rare_AetherShard.name: Aether Shard
LY_Rare_AetherShard.flavorText: No mere trinket, but a fragment of purest dream.
LY_Rare_AetherShard.effectDesc: #{J} Draw a card.#  At Noon — Draw a card.

LY_Rare_Alice.name: Alice
LY_Rare_Alice.supportDesc: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_AllIn.name: All In!
LY_Rare_AllIn.flavorText: There's a time to be cautious, and a time to bet it all!
LY_Rare_AllIn.effectDesc: Roll a die. #You may discard a card from your Reserve to increase the result by 2.# Target Character gains X boosts, where X is the final result.

LY_Rare_AloeVera.name: Aloe Vera
LY_Rare_AloeVera.effectDesc: #{J} You may pay {1} to have me gain $<ANCHORED>.#  At Noon — $<RESUPPLY>.

LY_Rare_AltrunTeammate.name: Altrun Teammate
LY_Rare_AltrunTeammate.flavorText: Altrun is a running and obstacle-dodging discipline that comes in very handy on these islands.
LY_Rare_AltrunTeammate.effectDesc: {J} You may <RUSH> to give #target Character# 1 boost. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

LY_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.name: Amahle, Asgarthan Outcast
LY_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.flavorText: The old world is dying, and the new world struggles to be born: now is the time of monsters.
LY_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.effectDesc: {J} You may discard #any number of cards# from your Reserve to #draw that many cards#.

LY_Rare_Anansi.name: Anansi
LY_Rare_Anansi.flavorText: In the end, he had accumulated pretty well all the wisdom that was available. He put it in a gourd and made a stopper for it.
LY_Rare_Anansi.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost for each card #in each player's Reserve#.

LY_Rare_Arawn.name: Arawn
LY_Rare_Arawn.flavorText: The Wild Hunt comes to free the restless spirits.

LY_Rare_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus
LY_Rare_Asmodeus.effectDesc: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain $<ANCHORED>. On a 1-3, I gain 3 boosts$<BB>.

LY_Rare_Avalanche.name: Avalanche
LY_Rare_Avalanche.flavorText: None of the snowflakes feel personally guilty for the avalanche.
LY_Rare_Avalanche.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve any number of target Characters with total {M} of 4 or less.

LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.name: BLISS Bassist
LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.flavorText: "This one's for all the explorers out there and all the hard work they do. They're not just monkeyin' around!" — Boona
LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.effectDesc: #If I'm <BOOSTED>, the {V}, {M}, and {O} of other Characters you control are equal to their highest statistic.#
LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.supportDesc: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.name: BLISS Drummer
LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.flavorText: "Throw your hands up in the air for everyone who's hauling out those amazing relics from the City of Scholars!" — Tamati
LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.effectDesc: If I'm <BOOSTED>, other #Artists# cost {1} less to play from your Reserve, with a minimum of {1}.
LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.supportDesc: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

LY_Rare_BLISSFan.name: BLISS Fan
LY_Rare_BLISSFan.flavorText: BLISS lets the fans who bring back the most Sap come up on stage with them.
LY_Rare_BLISSFan.effectDesc: When a Character in your Reserve gains 1 or more boosts — #Target Character# gains 1 boost.

LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.name: BLISS Keytarist
LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.flavorText: "Make some noise for all the brave folks pulling Sap up from the depths!" — Orbec
LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.effectDesc: At Dusk — If I'm <BOOSTED>, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an #Artist# or #Song#, draw it. Otherwise, discard it.
LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.supportDesc: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

LY_Rare_Bastet.name: Bastet
LY_Rare_Bastet.supportDesc: {D} : The next Character with Base Cost {3} or less you play this turn gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_BestowingSloth.name: Bestowing Sloth
LY_Rare_BestowingSloth.flavorText: "I'm not lazy, I'm just conserving energy."

LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.name: Bold Outrider
LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.flavorText: "I've found a way! A gap just two klicks away, straight ahead!"
LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.effectDesc: #{J} You may immediately play a Feat for {1} less, down to a minimum of {1}.#
LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#

LY_Rare_Brainwash.name: Brainwash
LY_Rare_Brainwash.flavorText: Like a worm in an apple, Silk squirmed into the Eidolon's mind to convert him to its Faction's interests.
LY_Rare_Brainwash.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Target a Character in any Reserve with Reserve Cost {2} or less. Play it for free. (Put it in one of your Expeditions.)

LY_Rare_BraveCub.name: Brave Cub
LY_Rare_BraveCub.flavorText: "Graaawr! The whole pack will stand with humankind, for the wolf is feared by all!"
LY_Rare_BraveCub.effectDesc: #{H} You may discard target non-Companion token.#

LY_Rare_BravosHarpooner.name: Bravos Harpooner
LY_Rare_BravosHarpooner.flavorText: Without explosive charges, these harpoons wouldn't even make a dent in Halua's hide.
LY_Rare_BravosHarpooner.effectDesc: #{J}# You may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

LY_Rare_BravosPathfinder.name: Bravos Pathfinder
LY_Rare_BravosPathfinder.flavorText: "Stay on the path, they say. I make my own path!"

LY_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.name: Bravos Trailblazer
LY_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.flavorText: "It will be a collective effort; it must be a joint endeavor!"
LY_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost #for each <FLEETING_CHAR> Character you control#.

LY_Rare_BreaktheIce.name: Break the Ice
LY_Rare_BreaktheIce.effectDesc: #$<COOLDOWN>#.  I cost {2} less if you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}).

LY_Rare_CableCarStation.name: Cable-Car Station
LY_Rare_CableCarStation.flavorText: Reka cable-cars are the safest way to get around the city.
LY_Rare_CableCarStation.effectDesc: {J} #Draw a card,# then I gain 2 Move counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Move counters: One of your Expeditions moves backwards one region. If it does, your other Expedition moves forward one region.

LY_Rare_Carbunclo.name: Carbunclo
LY_Rare_Carbunclo.flavorText: Is that a ruby on its forehead or a burning lump of coal ?
LY_Rare_Carbunclo.effectDesc: #{J}# If a card in your Expeditions or your Reserve has a {D} ability, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)

LY_Rare_CatsCradle.name: Cat's Cradle
LY_Rare_CatsCradle.flavorText: "Time to let the cat out of the bag!"
LY_Rare_CatsCradle.effectDesc: Target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less# switches Expeditions, then gains <ANCHORED>.

LY_Rare_Cernunnos.name: Cernunnos
LY_Rare_Cernunnos.flavorText: You can feel it in the trees, deep beneath their roots – the very heartbeat of nature.

LY_Rare_CheshireCat.name: Cheshire Cat
LY_Rare_CheshireCat.effectDesc: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may have target Character switch Expeditions. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Rare_Cleanse.name: Cleanse
LY_Rare_Cleanse.flavorText: "What do you think of my smoldering eyes?"
LY_Rare_Cleanse.effectDesc: Roll a die. #On a 1-3, I gain <FLEETING>.# Then, you may send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {X} or less, where X is the result. (Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

LY_Rare_ConiferalConeman.name: Coniferal Coneman
LY_Rare_ConiferalConeman.flavorText: "Dosukoi! Let’s put it in the ground!"

LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.name: Corrupted Esmeralda
LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.flavorText: \"Are you sure you want to follow me into hell, Fen ?\"
LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.effectDesc: I #can't be played# unless a {D} ability was activated this turn.  #{J}# <RESUPPLY>.
LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.supportDesc: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#

LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.name: Corrupted Paju
LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.flavorText: "Why did you survive, Treyst… but I died?"
LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless your hand is empty.  #{J}# Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.supportDesc: #{D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.#

LY_Rare_CountingSheep.name: Counting Sheep
LY_Rare_CountingSheep.flavorText: The deepest sleep is woven from the wool of sweet dreams.
LY_Rare_CountingSheep.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Target two Expeditions and create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in each one. Then, each Character with Hand Cost {1} or less gains <ASLEEP>.

LY_Rare_Daedalus.name: Daedalus
LY_Rare_Daedalus.flavorText: No one is truly lost, for all are exactly where fate wants them to be.
LY_Rare_Daedalus.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  #{J}# Target another Character #in play# or in Reserve. Then, roll a die:  • On a 4+, we both gain 1 boost.  • On a 1-3, it gains 1 boost.

LY_Rare_Daikokuten.name: Daikokuten
LY_Rare_Daikokuten.flavorText: If you never take a risk, you'll never be rewarded.
LY_Rare_Daikokuten.effectDesc: {J} Target opponent may immediately play a #card with Base Cost {4} or more# for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)

LY_Rare_Dapeng.name: Dapeng
LY_Rare_Dapeng.flavorText: With Turuun on its back, it carries a branch of the Spindle Tree in its beak.

LY_Rare_Dawon.name: Dawon
LY_Rare_Dawon.flavorText: "Come to me, Dawon, that I might summon the spirit of Durga!" — Parvati
LY_Rare_Dawon.effectDesc: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It gains <ANCHORED>.

LY_Rare_Defect.name: Defect
LY_Rare_Defect.flavorText: Changing sides isn't always a matter of choice.
LY_Rare_Defect.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Target Character #with Hand Cost {4} or less# defects. (It joins the Expedition facing it, changing controllers.)

LY_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.name: Diocles, Chariot Racer
LY_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.flavorText: "Hop in, it's a guaranteed five-star experience!"
LY_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.effectDesc: #Pay {3} more# to play me in a starting region.  {J} My Expedition moves backwards one region.  When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition moves forward one region.

LY_Rare_DonJuan.name: Don Juan
LY_Rare_DonJuan.effectDesc: If I would go to Reserve from the Expedition zone, I gain <FLEETING> and defect instead. (I join the Expedition facing me, changing controllers.)

LY_Rare_Doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
LY_Rare_Doppelganger.effectDesc: #$<SEASONED>.#  #{H}# Target a Character facing me. I gain its subtypes and X boosts, where X equals its highest statistic. (I lose these subtypes when I leave the Expedition zone.)

LY_Rare_DrFrankenstein.name: Dr. Frankenstein
LY_Rare_DrFrankenstein.flavorText: We sometimes seek companionship in the strangest of life forms.
LY_Rare_DrFrankenstein.effectDesc: {R} You may activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.

LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.name: Dredger Drone
LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.flavorText: The more you dig, the better your chances of finding something unique.
LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.effectDesc: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to <RESUPPLY_INF>.
LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.supportDesc: {I} #When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#

LY_Rare_DuelofGrit.name: Duel of Grit
LY_Rare_DuelofGrit.flavorText: Fiore was the first of the Seven Blades to clash with Atsadi.
LY_Rare_DuelofGrit.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  #Discard# target Character with Hand Cost less than or equal to the Hand Cost of a Character you control.

LY_Rare_EatMeEnergyBars.name: Eat Me Energy Bars
LY_Rare_EatMeEnergyBars.effectDesc: #{J} I gain <FLEETING>.#  If there is only one Character in my Expedition, it is <GIGANTIC>. (It is considered present in each of your Expeditions.)

LY_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.name: Efrén, Puppet Master
LY_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.flavorText: "I could never let the winding threads of fate separate me from my daughter." — Efrén
LY_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {H} Roll a die:  • On a 4+, <SABOTAGE_LOW>.  • On a 1-3, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.

LY_Rare_Encore.name: Encore
LY_Rare_Encore.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Target <FLEETING_CHAR> #or <BOOSTED># Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

LY_Rare_Eris.name: Eris
LY_Rare_Eris.flavorText: You win some, you lose some.
LY_Rare_Eris.effectDesc: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, roll a die. On a:  • 4+, it moves forward one more region instead.  #• 1, it doesn't move instead.#

LY_Rare_Esmeralda.name: Esmeralda
LY_Rare_Esmeralda.flavorText: Eidolon or not, you are our Shepherdess. You lead and we follow.

LY_Rare_FailedDemo.name: Failed Demo
LY_Rare_FailedDemo.flavorText: Not a failure; just another step towards success.
LY_Rare_FailedDemo.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve. If you do, send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or Hand Cost if not.)

LY_Rare_Finisher.name: Finisher
LY_Rare_Finisher.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Choose up to three, #you may choose the same option multiple times:#  • Discard target Character.  • Discard target Permanent.  • <SABOTAGE>.

LY_Rare_Flamel.name: Flamel
LY_Rare_Flamel.flavorText: Rubedo is the final stage of alchemy, where one's substance is reborn like a phoenix before returning to the world.
LY_Rare_Flamel.effectDesc: {H} You may return a Spell from your Reserve to your hand.
LY_Rare_Flamel.supportDesc: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.name: Flore, Caring Gardener
LY_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.flavorText: Every day that goes by without a Drillmole showing up is a blessing.
LY_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.supportDesc: {I} At Noon — Another target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.

LY_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.name: Flore, Fuming Gardener
LY_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.flavorText: "The Naos has been drained from intensive use!"
LY_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.effectDesc: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target Permanent in play. #Then you may exhaust# target card in Reserve.

LY_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.name: Flying Squirrel
LY_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.flavorText: The second big jump is where the fun really starts.
LY_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.effectDesc: {R} #If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts,# otherwise I gain 1 boost. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Rare_ForestNymph.name: Forest Nymph
LY_Rare_ForestNymph.flavorText: From an innocent seed, she creates wild forests.
LY_Rare_ForestNymph.effectDesc: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {V}, you may have target Character gain <FLEETING>.  #{R} You may move a {V} Terrain Marker from any region to my region.#

LY_Rare_FoulFaker.name: Foul Faker
LY_Rare_FoulFaker.effectDesc: #{J}# If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.name: Fragrant Meerkat
LY_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.flavorText: Do you smell a rat ? Nope, that's just me!
LY_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.effectDesc: #If you would roll a die, you may add 1 to its result.# (Choose after you see the result.)

LY_Rare_Galatea.name: Galatea
LY_Rare_Galatea.flavorText: If a sculptor merely frees the form from the stone, then it never belonged to him in the first place.
LY_Rare_Galatea.effectDesc: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I'm <DEFENDER_FS>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)  {J} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts.

LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.name: Galvanize the Troops
LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.flavorText: "In the dead of night, we must shine the brightest!"
LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>. Then, you may have target Character you control gain <FLEETING>.  When you pass — If you control two or more <FLEETING> Characters, complete me.
LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — If you are first player, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. #Otherwise, target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.#

LY_Rare_Gavroche.name: Gavroche
LY_Rare_Gavroche.flavorText: He fills his basket and retorts by thumbing his nose.
LY_Rare_Gavroche.effectDesc: {R} #You may discard a card from your Reserve to# create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.

LY_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.name: Gericht, Revered Duelist
LY_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.flavorText: "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger."
LY_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.effectDesc: #If I would gain <FLEETING_CHAR>, I gain 1 boost instead#.

LY_Rare_Hathor.name: Hathor
LY_Rare_Hathor.flavorText: Dance is the language of the soul.
LY_Rare_Hathor.supportDesc: {D} : Return another card from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_HavenSeiringar.name: Haven Seiringar
LY_Rare_HavenSeiringar.flavorText: Those who have lived a lot have plenty to share.
LY_Rare_HavenSeiringar.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition Zone, if I was <FLEETING_CHAR> — Draw a card.  #{R} I gain 1 boost.#

LY_Rare_Heimdall.name: Heimdall
LY_Rare_Heimdall.flavorText: Proud guardian of the Bifröst, he decides who gets to switch sides.
LY_Rare_Heimdall.effectDesc: {H} You may have target Character #or Expedition Permanent# switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

LY_Rare_Hooked.name: Hooked
LY_Rare_Hooked.effectDesc: Target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

LY_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.name: Hostel Nightkeeper
LY_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.flavorText: "Floor -2, room 217. Welcome to the Underlook Hostel."
LY_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.effectDesc: {H} You may target a Character, it gains <ASLEEP>. #If you control it,# create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.

LY_Rare_Hydracaena.name: Hydracaena
LY_Rare_Hydracaena.flavorText: When they reach adult size, it's clear that the Dracaenas have really thrived on all that rest and relaxation.
LY_Rare_Hydracaena.effectDesc: $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 4 boosts.  At Noon — I gain 4 boosts.

LY_Rare_Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
LY_Rare_Hypothermia.flavorText: Fall asleep in the cold, and you might never wake up.
LY_Rare_Hypothermia.effectDesc: Each player chooses a Character they control. It gains <ASLEEP>. (You choose first. Ignore the statistics of Asleep Characters during Dusk. At Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)

LY_Rare_IceboundTaiga.name: Icebound Taiga
LY_Rare_IceboundTaiga.flavorText: We can sense it in the woodland silences, like a tremor.
LY_Rare_IceboundTaiga.effectDesc: When you play a Character in {V} — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then it gains <ANCHORED>.

LY_Rare_IceboundTundra.name: Icebound Tundra
LY_Rare_IceboundTundra.flavorText: We can hear it, echoing in the vast expanses.
LY_Rare_IceboundTundra.effectDesc: When you play a Character in a region type where its base statistic is 0 — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then return a card from your Reserve to your hand.

LY_Rare_IsabelLetham.name: Isabel Letham
LY_Rare_IsabelLetham.flavorText: The lowest point of the wave is where she draws all her strength.

LY_Rare_Janus.name: Janus
LY_Rare_Janus.flavorText: "God of gates, it is time to close the Veil." — Sam
LY_Rare_Janus.effectDesc: $<GIGANTIC>.  When you discard a card from your hand #or your Reserve# — I gain 1 boost.

LY_Rare_Joyride.name: Joyride
LY_Rare_Joyride.flavorText: Everything fun is life is either forbidden or completely crazy.
LY_Rare_Joyride.effectDesc: Discard another card from your Reserve. If you do, target Character gains 2 boosts.

LY_Rare_JumpingFrog.name: Jumping Frog
LY_Rare_JumpingFrog.effectDesc: When you pass first — #Target Character# gains 1 boost.

LY_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.name: Kadigiran Mage-Dancer
LY_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.flavorText: "Don't just wait for magic to happen. Go out and make your own!"
LY_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.effectDesc: When you #roll one or more dice# — I gain 1 boost$<BB>.

LY_Rare_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.name: Kaibara, Asgarthan Leviathan
LY_Rare_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.flavorText: For hundreds of years, Kaibara has protected Asagartha.
LY_Rare_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.effectDesc: $<GIGANTIC>.  $<TOUGH_X>, where X is the number of regions between your Hero and Companion. (If they are adjacent, X equals 0.)

LY_Rare_Kappa.name: Kappa
LY_Rare_Kappa.flavorText: "Push through the pain. Giving up would hurt far more."

LY_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.name: Karhu, Lord of Bears
LY_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.flavorText: "Karhu, my old friend, wake from your slumber." — Rin
LY_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.effectDesc: {H} If you control another Animal #or an Artist,# draw a card.

LY_Rare_Kodama.name: Kodama
LY_Rare_Kodama.flavorText: There's no greater blessing for a tree than to offer a home for a Kodama.
LY_Rare_Kodama.supportDesc: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.name: Koi, Playful Leviathan
LY_Rare_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.flavorText: Its gracious leap parted the clouds, revealing our path forward.
LY_Rare_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.effectDesc: $<GIGANTIC>.  #{H} If neither of my Expeditions is in {M}, draw a card.#

LY_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
LY_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effectDesc: {H} #Return a card from your Reserve to your hand, then# exhaust all cards in Reserve.

LY_Rare_Lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
LY_Rare_Lakshmi.flavorText: Fortune smiles on those who give themselves over to it.
LY_Rare_Lakshmi.effectDesc: When you roll one or more dice — #If the result is 6+, draw a card.#
LY_Rare_Lakshmi.supportDesc: #{I} When you roll one or more dice — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.#

LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.name: Lakshmi's Owl
LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.flavorText: Even in the blackest night, I can see light.
LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.effectDesc: When you roll one or more dice — If I have no boosts, #I gain 1 boost#. $<BB>
LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.supportDesc: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#

LY_Rare_LernaeanHydra.name: Lernaean Hydra
LY_Rare_LernaeanHydra.flavorText: If you want to butt heads, it'll probably win...
LY_Rare_LernaeanHydra.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost per Mana Orb in your Mana Zone.

LY_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
LY_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effectDesc: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

LY_Rare_Loki.name: Loki
LY_Rare_Loki.effectDesc: {H} Each player discards their hand #and their Reserve#, then draws three cards.

LY_Rare_LostintheRiptide.name: Lost in the Riptide
LY_Rare_LostintheRiptide.flavorText: This is why you're supposed to read the map...
LY_Rare_LostintheRiptide.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Return target Character to the top of its owner's deck. #If it was in {O}, ready two Mana Orbs.#

LY_Rare_LostintheWoods.name: Lost in the Woods
LY_Rare_LostintheWoods.flavorText: They're not out of the woods yet.
LY_Rare_LostintheWoods.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send target Character to Reserve. #If it wasn't in {V}, its controller draws a card.#  • Discard target Permanent.

LY_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.name: Lucan, Hungry Leviathan
LY_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.flavorText: It bursts out of the clouds to devour our metal shuttles.
LY_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.effectDesc: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} You may discard any number of cards from your Reserve to give me that many boosts.

LY_Rare_LyraAerialist.name: Lyra Aerialist
LY_Rare_LyraAerialist.flavorText: The Cloth Dancers' great talent is to use every rough spot to adapt to their environment.
LY_Rare_LyraAerialist.effectDesc: #If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, my {V}, {M}, and {O} are equal to my highest statistic.#

LY_Rare_LyraChronicler.name: Lyra Chronicler
LY_Rare_LyraChronicler.flavorText: Eidolon or human, we are all shaped by stories. They're the building blocks of our identity.
LY_Rare_LyraChronicler.supportDesc: #{D} : <RESUPPLY>.# (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_LyraClothDancer.name: Lyra Cloth Dancer
LY_Rare_LyraClothDancer.flavorText: Hope you're not afraid of heights!
LY_Rare_LyraClothDancer.effectDesc: {H} #Each Character controlled by target player# gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)

LY_Rare_LyraContortionist.name: Lyra Contortionist
LY_Rare_LyraContortionist.flavorText: The Lyra from the Tisdhera clan will bend over backwards for their community.
LY_Rare_LyraContortionist.supportDesc: {I} I don't count towards your Reserve limit.

LY_Rare_LyraDJ.name: Lyra DJ
LY_Rare_LyraDJ.flavorText: There's something a bit unusual about this set…

LY_Rare_ManintheMaze.flavorText: Life is a maze, but our purpose is not to escape it. The purpose of life is the maze itself.
