MU_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.effectDesc: <GIGANTIC>.  #{J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target Expedition.#  {J} I gain 1 boost per Character in the Expeditions facing me.

NE_Common_Aerolith.name: Aerolith
NE_Common_Aerolith.flavorText: With aerolith, gravity no longer constrains how we build.
NE_Common_Aerolith.effectDesc: When I'm sacrificed — <RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.

NE_Common_DragonShade.name: Dragon Shade
NE_Common_DragonShade.flavorText: It is a shadow, a phantom, always hissing, always whispering. It wants to be found. It wants to be unleashed.
NE_Common_DragonShade.effectDesc: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)

NE_Common_Manaseed.name: Manaseed
NE_Common_Manaseed.flavorText: The Reka draw all of their riches from its Juice.
NE_Common_Manaseed.effectDesc: {T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.

OD_Common_AdamantReceptionist.name: Adamant Receptionist
OD_Common_AdamantReceptionist.flavorText: "You're not on the list. Please move along."
OD_Common_AdamantReceptionist.effectDesc: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one card from a Reserve.)

OD_Common_AegisTemplar.name: Aegis Templar
OD_Common_AegisTemplar.flavorText: The Templars always ensure that the area is safe.
OD_Common_AegisTemplar.effectDesc: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.

OD_Common_AngryCrowd.name: Angry Crowd
OD_Common_AngryCrowd.flavorText: Anger is often the fruit of frustration.
OD_Common_AngryCrowd.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Discard target Character or Permanent, then create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.

OD_Common_Anubis.name: Anubis
OD_Common_Anubis.flavorText: Only a heart as light as a feather can stand up to the judgment of Anubis.

OD_Common_Ariadne.name: Ariadne
OD_Common_Ariadne.flavorText: "Follow the thread, and you'll find me." — Ariadne
OD_Common_Ariadne.effectDesc: When an opponent plays a Character — If there are no Characters in the Expedition facing me, that Character switches Expeditions.

OD_Common_AscendedTrooper.name: Ascended Trooper
OD_Common_AscendedTrooper.flavorText: After months of expeditions, Aedyt felt she had finally spread her wings.
OD_Common_AscendedTrooper.effectDesc: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, I gain 1 boost. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_AyxasRepentedTyrant.name: Ayxas, Repented Tyrant
OD_Common_AyxasRepentedTyrant.flavorText: "I warned you of the danger you were heading into." — Ayxas
OD_Common_AyxasRepentedTyrant.effectDesc: {H} You may create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in an opponent's Expedition to <SABOTAGE_LOW>.

OD_Common_Benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
OD_Common_Benzaiten.flavorText: Good things come to those who wait.
OD_Common_Benzaiten.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, draw a card.

OD_Common_Bluecap.name: Bluecap
OD_Common_Bluecap.flavorText: To avoid sudden jolts, invest in stone.
OD_Common_Bluecap.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")

OD_Common_CelebrationDay.name: Celebration Day
OD_Common_CelebrationDay.flavorText: Today, and for centuries to come, we will celebrate victory over the Kraken and revel in freedom regained!
OD_Common_CelebrationDay.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Target Expedition can't move forward this Day.

OD_Common_Charge.name: Charge!
OD_Common_Charge.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Characters you control gain 1 boost$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Common_Charge.flavorText: Facing terrible odds and an unfathomably huge Leviathan, the Ordis legion charged nonetheless.

OD_Common_Conscription.name: Conscription
OD_Common_Conscription.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Target an Expedition. Create X <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in it, where X is the number of cards in target player's Reserve.

OD_Common_CorruptedGargoyle.name: Corrupted Gargoyle
OD_Common_CorruptedGargoyle.flavorText: They have always instilled fear. As a group, they instill terror.
OD_Common_CorruptedGargoyle.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  {H} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.

OD_Common_CorruptedJeanne.name: Corrupted Jeanne
OD_Common_CorruptedJeanne.flavorText: "I know they will all be driven out, except for those who die." — Jeanne
OD_Common_CorruptedJeanne.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.

OD_Common_CovertheRetreat.name: Cover the Retreat
OD_Common_CovertheRetreat.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.  When you pass — If seven or more Characters are in your Expeditions, complete me.
OD_Common_CovertheRetreat.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you create a token Character — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.name: Delay the Collapse
OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.flavorText: "Hold out for as long as possible. That's all that matters."
OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.effectDesc: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  When you pass — If the total Hand Cost of cards in your Landmarks is {6} or more, complete me.
OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Other cards in your Landmarks are <TOUGH_1>. (Opponents must pay {1} to target them.)

OD_Common_DongDaShen.name: Dong Da Shen
OD_Common_DongDaShen.effectDesc: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Common_Doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
OD_Common_Doppelganger.effectDesc: {J} Target a Character facing me. I gain its subtypes and X boosts, where X equals its highest statistic. (I lose these subtypes when I leave the Expedition zone.)

OD_Common_EbenezerScrooge.name: Ebenezer Scrooge
OD_Common_EbenezerScrooge.flavorText: Darkness is cheap, and that's why Scrooge liked it.
OD_Common_EbenezerScrooge.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Common_FieldReinforcements.name: Field Reinforcements
OD_Common_FieldReinforcements.flavorText: Supply lines can sometimes be the difference between failure and success.
OD_Common_FieldReinforcements.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Choose one. If each of your Expeditions is behind or tied, you may choose both:  • Draw a card.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.

OD_Common_FioredeiLiberi.name: Fiore dei Liberi
OD_Common_FioredeiLiberi.flavorText: "I am the sword, deadly against all weapons!" — Fiore
OD_Common_FioredeiLiberi.effectDesc: If I'm <BOOSTED>, I'm $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per other Character in my Expedition, then send them all to Reserve.  At Night — I lose 1 boost.

OD_Common_Galatea.name: Galatea
OD_Common_Galatea.flavorText: If a sculptor merely frees the form from the stone, then it never belonged to him in the first place.
OD_Common_Galatea.effectDesc: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I'm <DEFENDER_FS>. (My Expedition can't move forward during Dusk. I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)  {J} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts.

OD_Common_Gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
OD_Common_Gargoyle.flavorText: At the slightest sign of intrusion, these stone lookouts come to life and sound the alarm.
OD_Common_Gargoyle.effectDesc: {H} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_GrandEndeavor.name: Grand Endeavor
OD_Common_GrandEndeavor.flavorText: The Ordis built a relay of lighthouses to light the way through the Tumult.
OD_Common_GrandEndeavor.effectDesc: At Noon — Target Expedition moves forward one region.

OD_Common_GulrangTocsin.name: Gulrang & Tocsin
OD_Common_GulrangTocsin.flavorText: The Ordis way lies in patience and resilience.
OD_Common_GulrangTocsin.effectDesc: When you create a token Character — It gains 1 boost.  If you have less than eight Mana Orbs, <BOOSTED_TKN_P> tokens you control are <DEFENDER>. (Their Expeditions can't advance during Dusk.)

OD_Common_HealthInspector.name: Health Inspector
OD_Common_HealthInspector.flavorText: Using untested ingredients is a recipe for disaster.
OD_Common_HealthInspector.effectDesc: Cards in your opponent's Reserve can't gain counters.

OD_Common_Hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
OD_Common_Hippogriff.effectDesc: {H} My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When I leave an <ASCENDED_S> Expedition — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in it.

OD_Common_Hound.name: Hound
OD_Common_Hound.flavorText: Like a dog with a bone.
OD_Common_Hound.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, I gain 1 boost.

OD_Common_Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
OD_Common_Hypothermia.flavorText: Fall asleep in the cold, and you might never wake up.
OD_Common_Hypothermia.effectDesc: Each player chooses a Character they control. It gains <ASLEEP>. (You choose first. Ignore the statistics of Asleep Characters during Dusk. At Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)

OD_Common_IceboundLake.name: Icebound Lake
OD_Common_IceboundLake.flavorText: With a voice like thunder or crackling ice it howls.
OD_Common_IceboundLake.effectDesc: When you play a Character — If its Expedition is behind, I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then target Character gains <ASLEEP>.

OD_Common_Issitoq.name: Issitoq
OD_Common_Issitoq.flavorText: No one can escape their gaze.
OD_Common_Issitoq.effectDesc: Your other Expedition and the Expedition facing it can't move forward.
OD_Common_Issitoq.supportDesc: {D} : Draw a card. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Common_JeannedArc.name: Jeanne d'Arc
OD_Common_JeannedArc.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Common_JeannedArc.flavorText: She'll be followed long after she's gone.

OD_Common_KakobaLegionCommander.name: Kakoba, Legion Commander
OD_Common_KakobaLegionCommander.effectDesc: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, I gain 2 boosts$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Common_KakobaLegionCommander.flavorText: The general who became a scholar; the scholar who became a senator.

OD_Common_Kikimora.name: Kikimora
OD_Common_Kikimora.flavorText: Respect your household, and she will help you. But if you neglect it, beware!
OD_Common_Kikimora.supportDesc: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
OD_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effectDesc: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Common_LeoRelicExpert.name: Leo, Relic Expert
OD_Common_LeoRelicExpert.flavorText: Certain ancient knowledge must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.
OD_Common_LeoRelicExpert.effectDesc: At Night — You may spend 1 counter from a card in your Reserve or Landmarks to <SABOTAGE_INF> after Rest. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)

OD_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
OD_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effectDesc: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

OD_Common_LicenseWithdrawal.name: License Withdrawal
OD_Common_LicenseWithdrawal.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <BOOSTED> Character.  • Discard target Permanent.

OD_Common_LouisSullivan.name: Louis Sullivan
OD_Common_LouisSullivan.flavorText: "Form ever follows function. This is the law." — Louis Sullivan
OD_Common_LouisSullivan.effectDesc: {H} If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, draw a card.

OD_Common_Mandjet.name: Mandjet
OD_Common_Mandjet.flavorText: Mandjet and Mesektet, the Ordis flagships, reunited at last.
OD_Common_Mandjet.effectDesc: {T}: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_MatzHive.name: Matz & Hive
OD_Common_MatzHive.flavorText: I am the beating heart of the swarm, the architect of the hive.
OD_Common_MatzHive.effectDesc: (You may keep up to three cards in your Landmarks during Night.)  At Noon — If there are three or more cards in your Landmarks, you may sacrifice one. If you do, play for free a Landmark Permanent with a max Hand Cost of {2} more than the sacrificed card.

OD_Common_Melusine.name: Melusine
OD_Common_Melusine.effectDesc: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_Mesektet.name: Mesektet
OD_Common_Mesektet.flavorText: Repaired by the Axiom, the pride of the Aegis takes flight once again.
OD_Common_Mesektet.effectDesc: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.

OD_Common_MobileArmory.name: Mobile Armory
OD_Common_MobileArmory.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.

OD_Common_MonolithArchivist.name: Monolith Archivist
OD_Common_MonolithArchivist.flavorText: "The form has been filled out incorrectly. Please make a new appointment tomorrow."

OD_Common_MonolithLegate.name: Monolith Legate
OD_Common_MonolithLegate.flavorText: Your document has expired. Needless to say, that's not his problem.
OD_Common_MonolithLegate.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — $<SABOTAGE> after Rest.

OD_Common_MonolithRuneScribe.name: Monolith Rune-Scribe
OD_Common_MonolithRuneScribe.flavorText: The Ordis manifest their Alteration through the use of glyphs of power.

OD_Common_Nike.name: Nike
OD_Common_Nike.flavorText: When she spreads her wings, her victory shall resonate for all eternity.
OD_Common_Nike.effectDesc: $<ETERNAL_FS>.  At Noon — Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_NilsHolgersson.name: Nils Holgersson
OD_Common_NilsHolgersson.flavorText: Come on, saddle up! We need to fly in tight formation to evacuate as many as possible!

OD_Common_OpentheGates.name: Open the Gates
OD_Common_OpentheGates.effectDesc: Create two <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Common_OpentheGates.flavorText: For the first time in centuries, the Solstice Gate has opened. For the first time in ages, humanity will discover what lies beyond the gates.

OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.name: Ordis Accountant
OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.flavorText: He has an annoying tendency to overwhelm you with numbers.
OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.supportDesc: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Common_OrdisAttorney.name: Ordis Attorney
OD_Common_OrdisAttorney.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Draw a card.

OD_Common_OrdisCadets.name: Ordis Cadets
OD_Common_OrdisCadets.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisCadets.flavorText: Together they learn, and together they'll protect.

OD_Common_OrdisCarrier.name: Ordis Carrier
OD_Common_OrdisCarrier.effectDesc: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your Companion Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisCarrier.flavorText: The flow of Ordis Recruits seems to go on forever.

OD_Common_OrdisCrier.name: Ordis Crier
OD_Common_OrdisCrier.flavorText: He's surprisingly happy for someone who cries all day.
OD_Common_OrdisCrier.supportDesc: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.name: Ordis Dispatcher
OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.flavorText: She's in charge of every assignment within the garrison.
OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to create one <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your other Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.supportDesc: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Common_OrdisGatekeeper.name: Ordis Gatekeeper
OD_Common_OrdisGatekeeper.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your other Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisGatekeeper.flavorText: The Aegis Sentinel opened the door and stepped aside to let her through, acknowledging her with a nod as she passed.

OD_Common_OrdisLiaison.name: Ordis Liaison
OD_Common_OrdisLiaison.effectDesc: {J} Each other Character you control gains 1 boost.

OD_Common_OrdisMessenger.name: Ordis Messenger
OD_Common_OrdisMessenger.flavorText: To maintain their cohesion, the Ordis must call on the most reliable of couriers.
OD_Common_OrdisMessenger.effectDesc: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_OrdisNightwarden.name: Ordis Nightwarden
OD_Common_OrdisNightwarden.flavorText: Work doesn't stop when the sun goes down.
OD_Common_OrdisNightwarden.effectDesc: When I gain <ASLEEP> — I gain 1 boost.

OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.name: Ordis Overseer
OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.flavorText: Proper resource allocation can help make up for lost ground.
OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.supportDesc: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Common_OrdisRecruit.name: Ordis Recruit
OD_Common_OrdisRecruit.effectDesc: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)

OD_Common_OrdisSignet.name: Ordis Signet
OD_Common_OrdisSignet.effectDesc: Choose one:  • Target Character gains <ASLEEP>.  • Target Character in Expedition or in Reserve loses all its boosts.  • Each Character in target Expedition gains 1 boost.

OD_Common_OrdisTourist.name: Ordis Tourist
OD_Common_OrdisTourist.flavorText: "The more I visit this city, the more I love it."
OD_Common_OrdisTourist.effectDesc: {J} If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, I gain 1 boost.

OD_Common_OrdisTrooper.name: Ordis Trooper
OD_Common_OrdisTrooper.flavorText: "Chin up and stand tall. You’re shieldbearers of the Aegis now!"

OD_Common_OrdisWarden.name: Ordis Warden
OD_Common_OrdisWarden.flavorText: You can't beat the clink for catching forty winks.
OD_Common_OrdisWarden.effectDesc: {H} I gain $<ASLEEP>.  At Noon — Target player puts a card from their hand in Reserve.

OD_Common_OutofaClearSky.name: Out of a Clear Sky
OD_Common_OutofaClearSky.flavorText: A swarm of messages bursts forth in a rustling of paper.
OD_Common_OutofaClearSky.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  I cost {1} less if at least one of your Expeditions is Ascended.  Send target Character to Reserve.

OD_Common_OutofaDarkSky.name: Out of a Dark Sky
OD_Common_OutofaDarkSky.flavorText: Requests for assistance pour in at the sound of beating wings.
OD_Common_OutofaDarkSky.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. Then, if both of your Expeditions are <ASCENDED_S>, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.

OD_Common_Ozma.name: Ozma
OD_Common_Ozma.effectDesc: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Common_Ozma.flavorText: "Never give up. No one knows what’s going to happen next."

OD_Common_PaperEnvoy.name: Paper Envoy
OD_Common_PaperEnvoy.flavorText: "Give the order for all ships to retreat!"
OD_Common_PaperEnvoy.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless my Expedition is <ASCENDED_S>.

OD_Common_PaperHerald.name: Paper Herald
OD_Common_PaperHerald.flavorText: Words mean more than what is set down on paper.
OD_Common_PaperHerald.supportDesc: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Common_Pegasus.name: Pegasus
OD_Common_Pegasus.flavorText: Even one life saved is a victory for us!
OD_Common_Pegasus.effectDesc: When my Expedition would move forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION>, it moves forward one more region instead. (If it moved forward due to at least one matched stat.)

OD_Common_Quetzalcoatl.name: Quetzalcóatl
OD_Common_Quetzalcoatl.flavorText: A soul has yet to be found who is bold enough to contest his wisdom.
OD_Common_Quetzalcoatl.effectDesc: When an opponent draws one or more cards or does <RESUPPLY_T> — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.

OD_Common_RallyingCall.name: Rallying Call
OD_Common_RallyingCall.flavorText: The sound of the horn stirred them from their slumber as the white shadows emerged from the woods.
OD_Common_RallyingCall.effectDesc: Target Character gains 1 boost. If it is <ASLEEP>, it loses <ASLEEP>.

OD_Common_RekaCaterer.name: Reka Caterer
OD_Common_RekaCaterer.flavorText: "Happiness is always within reach, if you know how to savor it. Care for a smoothie?"
OD_Common_RekaCaterer.effectDesc: {J} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent token with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

OD_Common_RekaInvestor.name: Reka Investor
OD_Common_RekaInvestor.flavorText: "Trust me, it will all trickle down for everyone's benefit."
OD_Common_RekaInvestor.effectDesc: At Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

OD_Common_RekaPatron.name: Reka Patron
OD_Common_RekaPatron.flavorText: Art's value is in the eye of the beholder.
OD_Common_RekaPatron.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

OD_Common_RobinHood.name: Robin Hood
OD_Common_RobinHood.flavorText: Justice comes from a fair redistribution of wealth.
OD_Common_RobinHood.effectDesc: Characters your opponents play can't cost less than {2}. (If they would cost {1} or less, they cost {2} instead.)

OD_Common_RunesTestament.name: Rune's Testament
OD_Common_RunesTestament.flavorText: The first High King of Asgartha urges us to venture forth!
OD_Common_RunesTestament.effectDesc: If my Expedition would move forward, you may discard me instead to draw two cards.

OD_Common_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.name: Sagitta, Soaring Leviathan
OD_Common_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.flavorText: We flew higher to escape the turbulence of its wings.
OD_Common_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.effectDesc: I cost {1} less for each of your Ascended Expeditions.  $<GIGANTIC>.

OD_Common_SeekerOwl.name: Seeker Owl
OD_Common_SeekerOwl.flavorText: Its flight is silent and its talons sharp.
OD_Common_SeekerOwl.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition <ASCENDS>. (If I leave at Rest, it stays Ascended for the next Day.)

OD_Common_SigismarWingspan.name: Sigismar & Wingspan
OD_Common_SigismarWingspan.effectDesc: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your Hero Expedition. Ignore my abilities during the first Day
OD_Common_SigismarWingspan.flavorText: Follow me, friends! If we stand together, nothing can stop us!

OD_Common_Simurgh.name: Simurgh
OD_Common_Simurgh.flavorText: Three feathers. Each time you burn one, it will grant you its help.
OD_Common_Simurgh.effectDesc: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} If you have less cards in Reserve than target opponent, draw a card.

OD_Common_SkyboundOdyssey.name: Skybound Odyssey
OD_Common_SkyboundOdyssey.flavorText: Like a beacon, the horizon calls us onward!
OD_Common_SkyboundOdyssey.effectDesc: Draw a card.  Both of your Expeditions <ASCEND>. (Until Rest, they can move forward even if matched in their regions' terrains by the opponent's Expeditions.)  Immediately play for free up to two Characters with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)

OD_Common_Soar.name: Soar
OD_Common_Soar.flavorText: A Zephyr feather gives the Ordis the ability to fly.
OD_Common_Soar.effectDesc: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_Soar.supportDesc: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.

OD_Common_SouvenirSeller.name: Souvenir Seller
OD_Common_SouvenirSeller.effectDesc: {J} You may give me 1 boost. If you do, target opponent <RESUPPLIES>.

OD_Common_StaffClerk.name: Staff Clerk
OD_Common_StaffClerk.flavorText: Don't venture into the depths alone.
OD_Common_StaffClerk.effectDesc: When an opponent plays a card from Reserve — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.

OD_Common_StickyNoteSeals.name: Sticky Note Seals
OD_Common_StickyNoteSeals.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or more.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or more.
OD_Common_StickyNoteSeals.flavorText: Some lessons stick better than others.

OD_Common_StigmaofBanality.name: Stigma of Banality
OD_Common_StigmaofBanality.flavorText: To be afraid of being different is to destroy individuality.
OD_Common_StigmaofBanality.effectDesc: {H} You may discard target Character with Base Cost {2} or less. If you do, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in its Expedition. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

OD_Common_StrategicDeployment.name: Strategic Deployment
OD_Common_StrategicDeployment.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Target up to two Expeditions and create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of them.  • Target Character with Base Cost {2} or less switches Expeditions. (It joins its controller's other Expedition.)

OD_Common_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.name: Sunisa, Dedicated Ensign
OD_Common_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.flavorText: Forward or hold. There is no going back.
OD_Common_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.effectDesc: $<DEFENDER_FS>.  If my Expedition is behind, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent it from moving forward.

OD_Common_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.name: Sunisa, Ordis Bodyguard
OD_Common_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.flavorText: "Behind the smiles and jubilation, I sense a growing tension…"
OD_Common_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.effectDesc: $<DEFENDER_FS>.  If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.

OD_Common_Talos.name: Talos
OD_Common_Talos.flavorText: It was Talos's role to protect the statue from prying eyes.
OD_Common_Talos.effectDesc: $<GIGANTIC>.  <DEFENDER>. (My Expeditions can't move forward during Dusk.)

OD_Common_TeamworkTraining.name: Teamwork Training
OD_Common_TeamworkTraining.flavorText: Through their Hive Mind, Ordis turns the thoughts of the multitude into a unified will.
OD_Common_TeamworkTraining.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {X} or less, where X is the number of Characters you control.

OD_Common_TheConsulate.name: The Consulate
OD_Common_TheConsulate.flavorText: Here, far from the crowd, is where fruitful negotiations are held between Reka and Asgarthans.
OD_Common_TheConsulate.effectDesc: {J} Draw a card.  {T} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.

OD_Common_TheCouncil.name: The Council
OD_Common_TheCouncil.flavorText: The idea of facing the Council is deterrent enough for most would-be criminals in Asgartha.
OD_Common_TheCouncil.effectDesc: The {j}, {h} and {r} abilities of Characters facing me can't activate.

OD_Common_TheFrogPrince.name: The Frog Prince
OD_Common_TheFrogPrince.flavorText: Thankfully, he doesn't seal his contracts with a kiss.

OD_Common_TheLectern.name: The Lectern
OD_Common_TheLectern.flavorText: Sol may have sounded the alarm, but her words seem to be falling on deaf ears.
OD_Common_TheLectern.effectDesc: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  When I'm sacrificed — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> in a Hero Expedition. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)

OD_Common_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.name: The Monolith, Ordis Bastion
OD_Common_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.effectDesc: When a Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost$<BB>.
OD_Common_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.flavorText: A beacon of knowledge and order, a lighthouse towering high above the world.

OD_Common_TheOrigamium.name: The Origamium
OD_Common_TheOrigamium.effectDesc: {J} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)  When you play a Character — If it's in an Ascended Expedition, you may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

OD_Common_TheReunion.name: The Reunion
OD_Common_TheReunion.flavorText: "Two people separated by fate, now reunited once more! This reunion shall forever be carved in stone!"
OD_Common_TheReunion.effectDesc: {T} : Choose up to the number of cards in your Landmarks:  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in a Companion Expedition.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> in a Hero Expedition.  • Up to two target Characters gain 1 boost.

OD_Common_TheTownSquare.name: The Town Square
OD_Common_TheTownSquare.flavorText: In light of the Ordis' well-known organizational advantages, the Factions entrusted them with outpost logistics.
OD_Common_TheTownSquare.effectDesc: At Dusk — I gain 1 Morale counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 6 of my Morale counters: Characters in target Expedition gain 1 boost.

OD_Common_TheUglyDuckling.name: The Ugly Duckling
OD_Common_TheUglyDuckling.flavorText: This young recruit swans about while proudly showing off his insignia.
OD_Common_TheUglyDuckling.supportDesc: {D} : Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_Thoth.name: Thoth
OD_Common_Thoth.flavorText: "The pen is mightier than the sword."
OD_Common_Thoth.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition after Rest.

OD_Common_Thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
OD_Common_Thunderbird.effectDesc: {H} My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When my Expedition moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> (if it moved forward due to at least one matched stat) — Draw a card.

OD_Common_TinyJail.name: Tiny Jail
OD_Common_TinyJail.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with no statistic over 3.

OD_Common_UnfairEncounter.name: Unfair Encounter
OD_Common_UnfairEncounter.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Take control of target Landmark Permanent with Hand Cost {2} or less. (It joins your Landmarks.)

OD_Common_Valemon.name: Valemon
OD_Common_Valemon.flavorText: Promise me to wait, and I will show you my real face.
OD_Common_Valemon.effectDesc: Unless you have eight or more Mana Orbs, I am $<DEFENDER>.

OD_Common_WaruMack.name: Waru & Mack
OD_Common_WaruMack.flavorText: Bureaucracy is an art that requires careful planning.
OD_Common_WaruMack.effectDesc: When you play a Bureaucrat — It gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)

OD_Common_WigwaggingKiwi.name: Wigwagging Kiwi
OD_Common_WigwaggingKiwi.effectDesc: {J} I gain 1 boost per <ASCENDED_S> Expedition you control.

OD_Common_YannaQorganAgent.name: Yanna, Qorgan Agent
OD_Common_YannaQorganAgent.flavorText: Spies from the Qorgan infiltrate the Factions and steal their secrets.
OD_Common_YannaQorganAgent.effectDesc: {J} You may have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and loses Asleep.)

OD_Common_ZhenZephyr.name: Zhen & Zephyr
OD_Common_ZhenZephyr.flavorText: Those who stand without honor will fall without wings
OD_Common_ZhenZephyr.effectDesc: At Noon — If you are first player, your Hero Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)  When one or more of your Ascended Expeditions moves forward — If there is no Character facing it, draw a card.

OD_Exalted_AstrapeRekaHexarch.name: Astrape, Reka Hexarch
OD_Exalted_AstrapeRekaHexarch.flavorText: "I'm sure the Musubi ritual will help us understand your point of view."
OD_Exalted_AstrapeRekaHexarch.effectDesc: {J} Create three <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks. Then, I gain 1 boost per card in your Landmarks.

OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.name: Evacuate the City!
OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.flavorText: "The city is doomed. Prioritize the people!"
OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your <ASCENDED_S> Expeditions.  When one of your Expeditions moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> — Complete me.
OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — Your Companion Expedition <ASCENDS>, then create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in it.

OD_Exalted_PlagueofIntolerance.name: Plague of Intolerance
OD_Exalted_PlagueofIntolerance.flavorText: Intolerance is a mask for fear.
OD_Exalted_PlagueofIntolerance.effectDesc: {H} Sacrifice a Character. Then, depending on the number of Characters in your Expeditions:  • 2+: Draw a card.  • 4+: I also gain 2 boosts.  • 6+: Each other Character in your Expeditions also gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_APebbleinthePond.name: A Pebble in the Pond
OD_Rare_APebbleinthePond.flavorText: A single pebble can cause quite a ripple.
OD_Rare_APebbleinthePond.effectDesc: #Play me for {1} less if there are no tokens in your Landmarks.#  Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.

OD_Rare_AbySapCourier.name: Aby, Sap Courier
OD_Rare_AbySapCourier.flavorText: This wheel is the result of hours of mechanical training.
OD_Rare_AbySapCourier.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {J} <AUGMENT_IMP> #any number# of target cards in play or in Reserve. (If they have counters, they gain 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)

OD_Rare_Achilles.name: Achilles
OD_Rare_Achilles.flavorText: "Many things lie between us—shadowy mountains and sounding sea."

OD_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.name: Adamant Receptionist
OD_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.flavorText: "You're not on the list. Please move along."
OD_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.effectDesc: #{J}# You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to <SABOTAGE_INF>. #If you don't, I gain 1 boost.#

OD_Rare_AegisTemplar.name: Aegis Templar
OD_Rare_AegisTemplar.flavorText: The Templars always ensure that the area is safe.
OD_Rare_AegisTemplar.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in my Expedition.

OD_Rare_AerolithReef.name: Aerolith Reef
OD_Rare_AerolithReef.flavorText: Reaching the pillar is no easy journey, as the clouds conceal countless reefs and other dangers.
OD_Rare_AerolithReef.effectDesc: {J} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  #When I'm sacrificed — <RESUPPLY>.  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.#

OD_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.name: Amelia Earhart
OD_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.flavorText: "The most effective way to do it, is to do it."

OD_Rare_AngryCrowd.name: Angry Crowd
OD_Rare_AngryCrowd.flavorText: Anger is often the fruit of frustration.
OD_Rare_AngryCrowd.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Discard target Character or Permanent. #If its Base Cost was {2} or less,# create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting. Otherwise, it's the Hand Cost.)

OD_Rare_Anubis.name: Anubis
OD_Rare_Anubis.flavorText: Only a heart as light as a feather can stand up to the judgment of Anubis.

OD_Rare_Ariadne.name: Ariadne
OD_Rare_Ariadne.flavorText: "Follow the thread, and you'll find me." — Ariadne
OD_Rare_Ariadne.effectDesc: When an opponent plays a Character — If there are no Characters in the Expedition facing me, that Character switches Expeditions.

OD_Rare_ArmoredBird.name: Armored Bird
OD_Rare_ArmoredBird.flavorText: He raised a shield of feathers. Lances and harpoons shattered against his steely wings.
OD_Rare_ArmoredBird.effectDesc: I am $<DEFENDER> #unless I'm facing two or more Characters.#

OD_Rare_ArmoredJammer.name: Armored Jammer
OD_Rare_ArmoredJammer.flavorText: "In a jam? Sorry, mate. Maybe a side-effect of our scrambling..."

OD_Rare_AscendedTrooper.name: Ascended Trooper
OD_Rare_AscendedTrooper.flavorText: After months of expeditions, Aedyt felt she had finally spread her wings.
OD_Rare_AscendedTrooper.effectDesc: #{J}# If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, I gain 1 boost. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.

OD_Rare_Athena.name: Athena
OD_Rare_Athena.flavorText: "I’ve lifted the mist from off your eyes that’s blurred them up to now."
OD_Rare_Athena.effectDesc: #{H} If you control two or more other Characters, I gain 2 boosts.#  {R} If you control two or more #other Characters#, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.

OD_Rare_Atlas.name: Atlas
OD_Rare_Atlas.flavorText: Not even the weight of the sky could make him buckle.

OD_Rare_AxiomMachinist.name: Axiom Machinist
OD_Rare_AxiomMachinist.flavorText: From Kelon to Sap to Manaseed, the Axiom never stop experimenting with alternative energy sources.
OD_Rare_AxiomMachinist.effectDesc: #{J}# You may ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve.

OD_Rare_AxiomSignet.name: Axiom Signet
OD_Rare_AxiomSignet.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  • Target Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.

OD_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.name: Ayxas, Repented Tyrant
OD_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.flavorText: "I warned you of the danger you were heading into." — Ayxas
OD_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.effectDesc: {H} You may create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in an opponent's Expedition to <SABOTAGE_LOW>.

OD_Rare_BabaYaga.name: Baba Yaga
OD_Rare_BabaYaga.flavorText: Help or harm? Only the card will tell.

OD_Rare_BabasIsba.name: Baba's Isba
OD_Rare_BabasIsba.flavorText: Boney Legs, she's called, and her hut is one reason why.
OD_Rare_BabasIsba.effectDesc: {J} Draw a card.  {T}, Sacrifice a Character: $<AFTER_YOU>.

OD_Rare_BanishingGate.name: Banishing Gate
OD_Rare_BanishingGate.flavorText: Let me walk you to the door.

OD_Rare_Benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
OD_Rare_Benzaiten.flavorText: Good things come to those who wait.
OD_Rare_Benzaiten.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, draw a card. #Otherwise, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#

OD_Rare_Bluecap.name: Bluecap
OD_Rare_Bluecap.flavorText: To avoid sudden jolts, invest in stone.
OD_Rare_Bluecap.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. #If both of your Expeditions failed to move forward, create two instead.#

OD_Rare_BountifulMeadow.name: Bountiful Meadow
OD_Rare_BountifulMeadow.flavorText: There's no greater joy than seeing all that is green thrive and grow.
OD_Rare_BountifulMeadow.effectDesc: {T} : The next #Bureaucrat# you play this turn costs {1} less.

OD_Rare_BrassbugDropship.name: Brassbug Dropship
OD_Rare_BrassbugDropship.flavorText: "Those little pests are tough. Even three miles up, they still manage to follow us." - Subhash
OD_Rare_BrassbugDropship.effectDesc: When I'm sacrificed — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in each of your Expeditions. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)

OD_Rare_BrassbugHub.name: Brassbug Hub
OD_Rare_BrassbugHub.flavorText: Few people visit the depths of the Foundry, and even fewer can explain how the Brassbugs came to be.
OD_Rare_BrassbugHub.effectDesc: {J} I gain three Kelon counters.  At Noon — You may pay {1} and spend one of my Kelon counters to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

OD_Rare_BrassbugNursery.name: Brassbug Nursery
OD_Rare_BrassbugNursery.flavorText: Even far from their Hive, the Brassbugs have developed a way to continue reproducing.
OD_Rare_BrassbugNursery.effectDesc: {J} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.  {T}, {1}, Sacrifice a Permanent: create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

OD_Rare_BreaktheIce.name: Break the Ice
OD_Rare_BreaktheIce.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  I cost {2} less if #you control three or more Characters#.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Rare_BugOutBag.name: Bug-Out Bag
OD_Rare_BugOutBag.flavorText: They forgot to pack the Eat Me energy bars.
OD_Rare_BugOutBag.effectDesc: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in my Expedition.  #{R} <RESUPPLY>.#

OD_Rare_Bugfix.name: Bugfix
OD_Rare_Bugfix.flavorText: It's not Kelon, but this Sap will make you feel better, I swear.
OD_Rare_Bugfix.effectDesc: <COOLDOWN>.  You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.

OD_Rare_Bumblebeet.name: Bumblebeet
OD_Rare_Bumblebeet.flavorText: On the surface, pollination by bumblebeets is a key tool in growing Muna crops.
OD_Rare_Bumblebeet.supportDesc: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Rare_CableCarStation.name: Cable-Car Station
OD_Rare_CableCarStation.flavorText: Reka cable-cars are the safest way to get around the city.
OD_Rare_CableCarStation.effectDesc: {J} #Draw a card,# then I gain 2 Move counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Move counters: One of your Expeditions moves backwards one region. If it does, your other Expedition moves forward one region.

OD_Rare_Carbunclo.name: Carbunclo
OD_Rare_Carbunclo.flavorText: Is that a ruby on its forehead or a burning lump of coal ?
OD_Rare_Carbunclo.effectDesc: #{J} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition#, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)

OD_Rare_CelebrationDay.name: Celebration Day
OD_Rare_CelebrationDay.flavorText: Today, and for centuries to come, we will celebrate victory over the Kraken and revel in freedom regained!

OD_Rare_CelestialBlast.name: Celestial Blast
OD_Rare_CelestialBlast.flavorText: The sky cracked open in a thunderous wave as the dream was unleashed upon the world.
OD_Rare_CelestialBlast.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Discard up to two targets, Characters or Permanents.  #Draw a card.#

OD_Rare_Charge.name: Charge!
OD_Rare_Charge.flavorText: Facing terrible odds and an unfathomably huge Leviathan, the Ordis legion charged nonetheless.

OD_Rare_CharitableReka.name: Charitable Reka
OD_Rare_CharitableReka.flavorText: Opulence is a state of grace that forever teeters on the precipice.
OD_Rare_CharitableReka.effectDesc: #{J} Create a <MANASEED> token in each player's Landmarks.#

OD_Rare_Chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
OD_Rare_Chrysalis.flavorText: ...They build their ice cocoon to turn ethereal.
OD_Rare_Chrysalis.effectDesc: $<DEFENDER>.  When I leave the Expedition Zone — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.
OD_Rare_Chrysalis.supportDesc: #{D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_ConjuringSeal.name: Conjuring Seal
OD_Rare_ConjuringSeal.flavorText: The Imagination shapes our reality just as our beliefs shaped the Æther.

OD_Rare_Conscription.name: Conscription
OD_Rare_Conscription.effectDesc: #<COOLDOWN>.# (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Target an Expedition. Create X <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in it, where X is the number of cards in target player's Reserve.

OD_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.name: Corrupted Baba Yaga
OD_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.flavorText: "The Empyrean is flooded with Nightmare. It's spilling over." - Baba Yaga
OD_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} Draw a card.

OD_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.name: Corrupted Gargoyle
OD_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.flavorText: They have always instilled fear. As a group, they instill terror.
OD_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.effectDesc: #I can't be played# unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  #{J}# Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.

OD_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.name: Corrupted Jeanne
OD_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.effectDesc: #I can't be played# unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.supportDesc: #{D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#

OD_Rare_CovertheRetreat.name: Cover the Retreat
OD_Rare_CovertheRetreat.effectDesc: {J} Create two <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens #distributed among any Expeditions.#  When you pass — If #six# or more Characters are in your Expeditions, complete me.
OD_Rare_CovertheRetreat.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you create a token Character — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

OD_Rare_DaughterofNaos.name: Daughter of Naos
OD_Rare_DaughterofNaos.flavorText: The torture of the Naos must cease.

OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.name: Delay the Collapse
OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.flavorText: "Hold out for as long as possible. That's all that matters."
OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.effectDesc: {J} #Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.#  When you pass — If the total Hand Cost of cards in your Landmarks is {6} or more, complete me.
OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.supportDesc: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Other cards in your Landmarks are <TOUGH_1>.

OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.name: Designer Drone
OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.flavorText: Designed by designers to help them design.
OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.effectDesc: #{R} You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to reduce the cost of the next Permanent you play this Afternoon by {2}.#
OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.supportDesc: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#

OD_Rare_Detonation.name: Detonation
OD_Rare_Detonation.flavorText: Aerolith's instability can turn any bump into an explosive reaction.
OD_Rare_Detonation.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  You may sacrifice a Permanent to reduce my cost #by {2}.#  Send to Reserve target Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#

OD_Rare_DevotedProtector.name: Devoted Protector
OD_Rare_DevotedProtector.flavorText: "Come on! If we give up, it's game over!" — Kebba
OD_Rare_DevotedProtector.effectDesc: #{R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost.#

OD_Rare_DongDaShen.name: Dong Da Shen
OD_Rare_DongDaShen.effectDesc: #At Noon — #You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Rare_Doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
OD_Rare_Doppelganger.effectDesc: #$<SEASONED>.#  #{H}# Target a Character facing me. I gain its subtypes and X boosts, where X equals its highest statistic. (I lose these subtypes when I leave the Expedition zone.)

OD_Rare_Drillmole.name: Drillmole
OD_Rare_Drillmole.effectDesc: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
OD_Rare_Drillmole.supportDesc: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#

OD_Rare_DrowsyDodo.name: Drowsy Dodo
OD_Rare_DrowsyDodo.flavorText: After all that work, it's time for the dodo to go night-night.
OD_Rare_DrowsyDodo.effectDesc: {J} I gain <ASLEEP>.  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — #I gain 1 boost.#

OD_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.name: Ebenezer Scrooge
OD_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.flavorText: Darkness is cheap, and that's why Scrooge liked it.
OD_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.supportDesc: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.name: Eru, Emissary of the Wild
OD_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.flavorText: "Surrounded by all of his animal friends, my teacher never felt alone, even living as a hermit." - Kauri
OD_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.effectDesc: #{H} You may have target Character facing me gain <ANCHORED>. If you do, I gain $<ANCHORED>.#

OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.name: Feast of Thoughts
OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.flavorText: When the Remanence strikes, ideas burst out of one's mind like water from a dam.
OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.effectDesc: Choose X+1, where X is my number of Arcane counters:  • Draw a card.  • Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  • Remove 3 counters from target card in play or in Reserve.  • <SABOTAGE>.
OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.supportDesc: {I} When #a Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.

OD_Rare_FieldReinforcements.name: Field Reinforcements
OD_Rare_FieldReinforcements.flavorText: Supply lines can sometimes be the difference between failure and success.
OD_Rare_FieldReinforcements.effectDesc: #$<COOLDOWN>.#  Choose one. If each of your Expeditions is behind or tied, you may choose both:  • Draw a card.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.

OD_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.name: Fiore dei Liberi
OD_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.flavorText: "I am the sword, deadly against all weapons!" — Fiore
OD_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.effectDesc: If I'm <BOOSTED>, I'm $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per other Character in my Expedition, then send them all to Reserve.  At Night — I lose 1 boost.

OD_Rare_FireRabbit.name: Fire Rabbit
OD_Rare_FireRabbit.flavorText: Hot bunny in your area wants to meet!
OD_Rare_FireRabbit.effectDesc: {H} You may have me gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. If you do, another target Character gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_FortheGreaterGood.name: For the Greater Good
OD_Rare_FortheGreaterGood.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Discard a card from your hand. If you do, discard target card in play with Base Cost #{5} or less#.

OD_Rare_FoundryEngineer.name: Foundry Engineer
OD_Rare_FoundryEngineer.flavorText: Behind every Axiom masterwork, there are Foundry Engineers.
OD_Rare_FoundryEngineer.effectDesc: {R} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs #{2}# less.

OD_Rare_FoundryMechanic.name: Foundry Mechanic
OD_Rare_FoundryMechanic.flavorText: You can't choose when and where a quick fix will be needed.
OD_Rare_FoundryMechanic.supportDesc: {D} : The next Permanent you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.name: Fragrant Meerkat
OD_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.flavorText: Do you smell a rat ? Nope, that's just me!
OD_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.effectDesc: #If you would roll a die, you may add 1 to its result.# (Choose after you see the result.)

OD_Rare_Galatea.name: Galatea
OD_Rare_Galatea.flavorText: If a sculptor merely frees the form from the stone, then it never belonged to him in the first place.
OD_Rare_Galatea.effectDesc: I'm <DEFENDER_FS>.  #If my Expedition is <IN_CONTACT>, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent it from moving forward.# (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

OD_Rare_Gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
OD_Rare_Gargoyle.flavorText: At the slightest sign of intrusion, these stone lookouts come to life and sound the alarm.

OD_Rare_Geyser.name: Geyser
OD_Rare_Geyser.effectDesc: Return target Character or Permanent to its owner's hand, then put me in your Mana Orbs (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

OD_Rare_Gibil.name: Gibil
OD_Rare_Gibil.flavorText: Symphonies begin with two notes, fires with a couple of sparks, and masterpieces with two drops of metal.
OD_Rare_Gibil.effectDesc: {J} #If you control two or more Permanents, create two <BRASSBUG> Robot tokens in target Expedition. Otherwise,# create only one.
OD_Rare_Gibil.supportDesc: {D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_GiftofSelf.name: Gift of Self
OD_Rare_GiftofSelf.flavorText: Her being begins to disintegrate as she breaks all the Mana bridges linking the idea of who she is to physical matter.
OD_Rare_GiftofSelf.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, draw two cards.

OD_Rare_GranBwa.name: Gran Bwa
OD_Rare_GranBwa.flavorText: Make an offering of Sap and spiced rum, and Gran Bwa will bless your orchard.
OD_Rare_GranBwa.effectDesc: {J} You may have target opponent draw a card. If you do, I gain <ANCHORED>.  #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_GranBwa.supportDesc: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Rare_GrandEndeavor.name: Grand Endeavor
OD_Rare_GrandEndeavor.flavorText: The Ordis built a relay of lighthouses to light the way through the Tumult.
OD_Rare_GrandEndeavor.effectDesc: #$<TOUGH_2>.#  At Noon — Target Expedition moves forward one region.

OD_Rare_HavenTrainee.name: Haven Trainee
OD_Rare_HavenTrainee.flavorText: "All right, lad, show me what you’ve learned."
OD_Rare_HavenTrainee.effectDesc: {R} #Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.#

OD_Rare_HavenWarrior.name: Haven Warrior
OD_Rare_HavenWarrior.flavorText: We've all lived through some things. But she's been through worse.
OD_Rare_HavenWarrior.supportDesc: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_HealthInspector.name: Health Inspector
OD_Rare_HealthInspector.flavorText: Using untested ingredients is a recipe for disaster.
OD_Rare_HealthInspector.effectDesc: #Cards in play or in Reserve with counters# can't gain counters. (This doesn't affect Hero cards.)

OD_Rare_Heimdall.name: Heimdall
OD_Rare_Heimdall.flavorText: Proud guardian of the Bifröst, he decides who gets to switch sides.
OD_Rare_Heimdall.effectDesc: {H} You may have target Character switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

OD_Rare_HelpfulPelican.name: Helpful Pelican
OD_Rare_HelpfulPelican.flavorText: It's not unusual to see these pelicans ferrying small local creatures from one island to the next.
OD_Rare_HelpfulPelican.effectDesc: #When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — If my Expedition is Ascended, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#

OD_Rare_Hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
OD_Rare_Hippogriff.effectDesc: #{J}# My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When my Expedition #moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION># — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in that Expedition after Rest.

OD_Rare_HopomyThumb.name: Hop-o'-my-Thumb
OD_Rare_HopomyThumb.flavorText: It's not easy to lead the way…
OD_Rare_HopomyThumb.effectDesc: #{H}# You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.

OD_Rare_Hound.name: Hound
OD_Rare_Hound.flavorText: Like a dog with a bone.
OD_Rare_Hound.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, I gain 1 boost.

OD_Rare_Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
OD_Rare_Hypothermia.flavorText: Fall asleep in the cold, and you might never wake up.
OD_Rare_Hypothermia.effectDesc: Each player chooses a Character they control. It gains <ASLEEP>. (You choose first. Ignore the statistics of Asleep Characters during Dusk. At Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)

OD_Rare_IceboundLake.name: Icebound Lake
OD_Rare_IceboundLake.flavorText: With a voice like thunder or crackling ice it howls.
OD_Rare_IceboundLake.effectDesc: When you play a Character — If its Expedition is behind, I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then target Character gains <ASLEEP>.

OD_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.name: Investigate the Corruption
OD_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.flavorText: \"By understanding the evil, we can pull it out at the root.\" - Zaj
OD_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Draw #three cards#, then discard a card from your hand.

OD_Rare_Issitoq.name: Issitoq
OD_Rare_Issitoq.flavorText: No one can escape their gaze.
OD_Rare_Issitoq.effectDesc: Your other Expedition and the Expedition facing it can't move forward.
OD_Rare_Issitoq.supportDesc: {D} : Draw a card. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_JackFrost.name: Jack Frost
OD_Rare_JackFrost.flavorText: Another holiday... Just the icing on the cake!
OD_Rare_JackFrost.effectDesc: #{J}# You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Rare_JeannedArc.name: Jeanne d'Arc
OD_Rare_JeannedArc.effectDesc: When I leave the Expedition zone — Create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Rare_JeannedArc.flavorText: She'll be followed long after she's gone.

OD_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.name: Jian, Assembly Overseer
OD_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.flavorText: "This material does not seem to be affected by gravity. By harnessing the properties of this Aerolith, we could create flying ships and cities, and fly close to the clouds..."
OD_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.supportDesc: #{D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_KadigiranAlchemist.name: Kadigiran Alchemist
OD_Rare_KadigiranAlchemist.flavorText: Alchemy is not just a matter of turning lead to gold. It's about purifying yourself of imperfections to become your true self.

OD_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.name: Kakoba, Legion Commander
OD_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.effectDesc: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, I gain #3 boosts$<BB>#. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.flavorText: The general who became a scholar; the scholar who became a senator.

OD_Rare_KelonBurst.name: Kelon Burst
OD_Rare_KelonBurst.flavorText: There's an enduring legend in the Suspira quarries: the existence of another type of Kelon.
OD_Rare_KelonBurst.effectDesc: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.

OD_Rare_KelonicGenerator.name: Kelonic Generator
OD_Rare_KelonicGenerator.flavorText: "Suspira's mines will soon run dry. Your precious Kelon will run dry."

OD_Rare_Kikimora.name: Kikimora
OD_Rare_Kikimora.flavorText: Respect your household, and she will help you. But if you neglect it, beware!
OD_Rare_Kikimora.effectDesc: #When you play a Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_Kikimora.supportDesc: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.

OD_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
OD_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effectDesc: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. #Then, target an Expedition that's ahead. Each of its Characters gain <ASLEEP>.#

OD_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.name: Kuwat, the Dissenter
OD_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.flavorText: "There are gates one should not open, there are seals one should not breach. And yet I will."
OD_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.effectDesc: {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.

OD_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.name: Leo, Relic Expert
OD_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.flavorText: Certain ancient knowledge must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.

OD_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.name: Leonardo da Vinci
OD_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.flavorText: "The noblest pleasure is the joy of understanding." — Leonardo da Vinci
OD_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.effectDesc: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to #draw a card.#

OD_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
OD_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effectDesc: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

OD_Rare_LicenseWithdrawal.name: License Withdrawal
OD_Rare_LicenseWithdrawal.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <BOOSTED> Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#  • Discard target Permanent #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#

OD_Rare_LouisSullivan.name: Louis Sullivan
OD_Rare_LouisSullivan.flavorText: "Form ever follows function. This is the law." — Louis Sullivan
OD_Rare_LouisSullivan.effectDesc: #{J}# If there are #three or more# cards in your Landmarks, draw a card.

OD_Rare_LuminousSwarm.name: Luminous Swarm
OD_Rare_LuminousSwarm.flavorText: They buzz about at night and spread their nectar when the sun is at its height.
OD_Rare_LuminousSwarm.effectDesc: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  At Noon — Target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_Mandjet.name: Mandjet
OD_Rare_Mandjet.flavorText: Mandjet and Mesektet, the Ordis flagships, reunited at last.
OD_Rare_Mandjet.effectDesc: {T}: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.  #If one of your Ascended Expeditions would attempt to <ASCEND_INF> again, <RESUPPLY_LOW> instead.#

OD_Rare_MasterLapidary.name: Master Lapidary
OD_Rare_MasterLapidary.flavorText: Cutting Aerolith requires a deft and delicate touch.
OD_Rare_MasterLapidary.effectDesc: #{H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to ready a Mana Orb.#

OD_Rare_Melusine.name: Melusine
OD_Rare_Melusine.effectDesc: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.

OD_Rare_Mesektet.name: Mesektet
OD_Rare_Mesektet.flavorText: Repaired by the Axiom, the pride of the Aegis takes flight once again.
OD_Rare_Mesektet.effectDesc: #{J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.#  At Noon — Create a <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.

OD_Rare_MigratoryCrane.name: Migratory Crane
OD_Rare_MigratoryCrane.flavorText: When the cranes start their migration, that's the signal that it's time to seek out new horizons.
OD_Rare_MigratoryCrane.effectDesc: When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — You may have me switch Expeditions.

OD_Rare_MobileArmory.name: Mobile Armory
OD_Rare_MobileArmory.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.  #<DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.#

OD_Rare_MonolithArchivist.name: Monolith Archivist
OD_Rare_MonolithArchivist.flavorText: "The form has been filled out incorrectly. Please make a new appointment tomorrow."
OD_Rare_MonolithArchivist.effectDesc: #I am $<DEFENDER> unless you control two or more other Bureaucrats.#

OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.name: Monolith Legate
OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.flavorText: Your document has expired. Needless to say, that's not his problem.
OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — $<SABOTAGE> after Rest.
OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.supportDesc: #{D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_MonolithRuneScribe.name: Monolith Rune-Scribe
OD_Rare_MonolithRuneScribe.flavorText: The Ordis manifest their Alteration through the use of glyphs of power.

OD_Rare_MothCollision.name: Moth Collision
OD_Rare_MothCollision.flavorText: When two moths meet, there's always a spark.
OD_Rare_MothCollision.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  If you control a #Soldier#, I cost {1} less.  Discard target Character.

OD_Rare_MothLantern.name: Moth Lantern
OD_Rare_MothLantern.flavorText: In the tricks of its light, shed your skin to become an illusion.
OD_Rare_MothLantern.effectDesc: When you sacrifice a non-Illusion Character — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.  {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.

OD_Rare_MothtoaFlame.name: Moth to a Flame
OD_Rare_MothtoaFlame.flavorText: During the scant hours of their brief existence, the Moths flutter about, carrying only the idea of themselves.
OD_Rare_MothtoaFlame.effectDesc: $<COOLDOWN>.  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token #in each of your Expeditions#.

OD_Rare_MothtoaSpring.name: Moth to a Spring
OD_Rare_MothtoaSpring.flavorText: A spring that will quench any thirst for magic.
OD_Rare_MothtoaSpring.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Create #two# <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens, distributed among any Expeditions.  Draw a card.

OD_Rare_Nike.name: Nike
OD_Rare_Nike.flavorText: When she spreads her wings, her victory shall resonate for all eternity.
OD_Rare_Nike.effectDesc: #If my Expedition is Ascended,# I am $<ETERNAL_FS>.

OD_Rare_NikolaTesla.name: Nikola Tesla
OD_Rare_NikolaTesla.flavorText: "With this new invention, we can generate a force field to protect the city!"
OD_Rare_NikolaTesla.effectDesc: {R} I gain 1 boost #per# exhausted Permanent you control and #per# exhausted card in your Reserve, up to a max of 3 boosts on me.

OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.name: Nils Holgersson
OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.flavorText: Come on, saddle up! We need to fly in tight formation to evacuate as many as possible!
OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.effectDesc: #{H} You may target a Character with Base Cost {1} or less. It switches Expeditions.#
OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.supportDesc: #{D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#

OD_Rare_Nurture.name: Nurture
OD_Rare_Nurture.flavorText: When the sun shines, we'll shine together.
OD_Rare_Nurture.effectDesc: Up to two target Characters each gain 1 boost.

OD_Rare_OpentheGates.name: Open the Gates
OD_Rare_OpentheGates.effectDesc: Create #four# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens, #distributed as you choose among any number of target Expeditions#.
OD_Rare_OpentheGates.flavorText: For the first time in centuries, the Solstice Gate has opened. For the first time in ages, humanity will discover what lies beyond the gates.

OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.name: Ordis Accountant
OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.flavorText: He has an annoying tendency to overwhelm you with numbers.
OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. #You may give it 2 boosts.#
OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.supportDesc: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Rare_OrdisAttorney.name: Ordis Attorney
OD_Rare_OrdisAttorney.effectDesc: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Draw a card.

OD_Rare_OrdisCadets.name: Ordis Cadets
OD_Rare_OrdisCadets.flavorText: Together they learn, and together they'll protect.
OD_Rare_OrdisCadets.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #your other Expedition#.

OD_Rare_OrdisCarrier.name: Ordis Carrier
OD_Rare_OrdisCarrier.flavorText: The flow of Ordis Recruits seems to go on forever.
OD_Rare_OrdisCarrier.effectDesc: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #each of your Expeditions#.

OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.name: Ordis Crier
OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.flavorText: He's surprisingly happy for someone who cries all day.
OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.effectDesc: #{R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to ready two Mana Orbs.#
OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.supportDesc: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.name: Ordis Dispatcher
OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.flavorText: She's in charge of every assignment within the garrison.
OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.effectDesc: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in your other Expedition.
OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.supportDesc: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.

OD_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.name: Ordis Gatekeeper
OD_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.effectDesc: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #each of your# Expeditions.
OD_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.flavorText: The Aegis Sentinel opened the door and stepped aside to let her through, acknowledging her with a nod as she passed.

OD_Rare_OrdisLiaison.name: Ordis Liaison
OD_Rare_OrdisLiaison.effectDesc: {J} Each Character #in target Expedition# gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_OrdisMessenger.name: Ordis Messenger
OD_Rare_OrdisMessenger.flavorText: To maintain their cohesion, the Ordis must call on the most reliable of couriers.
OD_Rare_OrdisMessenger.effectDesc: #{J}# If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, #create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.# Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.

OD_Rare_OrdisNightwarden.name: Ordis Nightwarden
OD_Rare_OrdisNightwarden.flavorText: Work doesn't stop when the sun goes down.
OD_Rare_OrdisNightwarden.effectDesc: If I would gain <ASLEEP>, #I gain $<ANCHORED> instead.#

OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.name: Ordis Overseer
OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.flavorText: Proper resource allocation can help make up for lost ground.
OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.effectDesc: {J} If my Expedition is behind, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition #for each Bureaucrat you control#.
OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.supportDesc: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_OrdisSignet.name: Ordis Signet
OD_Rare_OrdisSignet.effectDesc: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Target Character gains <ASLEEP>.  • Target Character in Expedition or in Reserve loses all its boosts.  • Each Character in target Expedition gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_OrdisSpy.name: Ordis Spy
OD_Rare_OrdisSpy.effectDesc: {H} $<SABOTAGE>.  #{R} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.#

OD_Rare_OrdisTourist.name: Ordis Tourist
OD_Rare_OrdisTourist.flavorText: "The more I visit this city, the more I love it."
OD_Rare_OrdisTourist.effectDesc: {J} I gain #1 boost per card in your Landmarks, up to a max of 3 boosts on me.#

OD_Rare_OrdisTrooper.name: Ordis Trooper
OD_Rare_OrdisTrooper.flavorText: "Chin up and stand tall. You’re shieldbearers of the Aegis now!"

OD_Rare_OrdisWarden.name: Ordis Warden
OD_Rare_OrdisWarden.flavorText: You can't beat the clink for catching forty winks.
OD_Rare_OrdisWarden.effectDesc: {H} #You may have me# gain <ASLEEP>.  At Noon — Target player puts a card from their hand in Reserve.

OD_Rare_OutofaClearSky.name: Out of a Clear Sky
OD_Rare_OutofaClearSky.flavorText: A swarm of messages bursts forth in a rustling of paper.
OD_Rare_OutofaClearSky.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  I cost #{1} less for each# of your Ascended Expeditions.  Send target Character to Reserve.

OD_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.name: Out of a Dark Sky
OD_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.flavorText: Requests for assistance pour in at the sound of beating wings.
OD_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less.# Then, if both of your Expeditions are <ASCENDED_S>, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.

OD_Rare_Ozma.name: Ozma
OD_Rare_Ozma.effectDesc: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Rare_Ozma.flavorText: "Never give up. No one knows what’s going to happen next."

OD_Rare_PaintitPink.name: Paint it Pink!
OD_Rare_PaintitPink.effectDesc: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less #per Expedition# <IN_CONTACT> that you control. (They're In Contact if another player's Expedition is in their region.)  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.

OD_Rare_Pan.name: Pan
OD_Rare_Pan.flavorText: He's definitely the black sheep around here!
OD_Rare_Pan.effectDesc: {H} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a card this way, create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Companion Expedition of its owner. #You may have it gain <ASLEEP>.#

OD_Rare_PaperEnvoy.name: Paper Envoy
OD_Rare_PaperEnvoy.flavorText: "Give the order for all ships to retreat!"
OD_Rare_PaperEnvoy.effectDesc: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless #one of your Expeditions# is <ASCENDED_S>.

OD_Rare_PaperHerald.name: Paper Herald
OD_Rare_PaperHerald.flavorText: Words mean more than what is set down on paper.
OD_Rare_PaperHerald.supportDesc: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_Pegasus.name: Pegasus
OD_Rare_Pegasus.flavorText: Even one life saved is a victory for us!
OD_Rare_Pegasus.effectDesc: #{J} Each of your Expeditions <ASCENDS>.#   When #both of your Expeditions# move forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> — #You win the game.#

OD_Rare_PicnicArea.name: Picnic Area
OD_Rare_PicnicArea.effectDesc: {J} Each player #draws a card.#  When you make a <GIFT> — You may exhaust me ({T}) to have target Character gain 1 boost. (A Gift is when on your turn, an opponent draws a card, Resupplies or receives a token.)

OD_Rare_QorganInformant.name: Qorgan Informant
OD_Rare_QorganInformant.flavorText: Shhh. This stays between you and me.
OD_Rare_QorganInformant.effectDesc: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  {H} Remove up to 2 counters from target card in play or in Reserve. (This can't target Hero cards.)

OD_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.name: Quetzalcóatl
OD_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.flavorText: A soul has yet to be found who is bold enough to contest his wisdom.
OD_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.effectDesc: When an opponent draws one or more cards or does <RESUPPLY_T> — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.

YZ_Common_ConjuringSeal.name: Conjuring Seal
